multipliers.name: Cursed Chests
multipliers.behavior:
Landed Cursed Chests open up to create a Cursed Area from their position to the top of the reel, if the Cursed Area would include at least one winning combination.

 Opened Cursed Chests reveal a Cursed Multiplier that is applied to the Cursed Area on that reel. All winning paylines that include a symbol in the Cursed Area are multiplied by the multiplier for that Cursed Area. If a winning payline is affected by more than one multiplier, the multiplier values are added together before being applied to the win.

 Cursed Chest multipliers can have one of the following values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 200x

modes.name: Sunken Treasure bonus game
modes.trigger: Land 3 Lantern scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to trigger this bonus feature that starts with 10 free spins.
modes.effects:
Land 3 Lantern scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to trigger this bonus feature that starts with 10 free spins.

 In this bonus feature, Cursed Chests that land always open and create a Cursed Area that persists until the end of the feature. The Cursed Area on a reel grows if a new Cursed Chest lands below it.

 All Cursed Multipliers from opened Cursed Chests are added to a Total Multiplier above the reels, which affects all Cursed Areas. All winning paylines that pass through any Cursed Areas are multiplied by the Total Multiplier.

 Landing additional Lantern symbols at the same time during the feature awards extra free spins:

 2 Lantern symbols awards 2 additional spins.
3 Lantern symbols awards 4 additional spins.
4 Lantern symbols awards 6 additional spins.

modes.name: Dead Men Tell No Tales bonus game
modes.trigger: Land 4 Lantern scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to trigger this bonus feature in which you get 3 refilling lives.
modes.effects:
Land 4 Lantern scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to trigger this bonus feature in which you get 3 refilling lives. Each life equals one free spin.

 This feature contains only non-winning symbols and special Skull and Kraken symbols.

 Above each reel is a multiplier value that starts at 1x and can be progressively increased throughout the feature.

 The Cursed Skull symbol reveals a multiplier value that is added to the total multiplier above the reel where it landed and creates a Cursed Area from its position to the top of the reel. The Cursed Area on a reel grows if a new Cursed Skull lands below it.

 Cursed Skull multipliers can have one of the following values: 1x, 2x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 150x, 200x, 250x, 500x

 The Tormented Skull symbol reveals a multiplier value that multiplies the total multiplier above the reel where it landed.

 Tormented Skull multipliers can have one of the following values: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x15, x20, x25

 The Kraken symbol reveals a multiplier value that is added to the total multiplier above all reels.

 Kraken multipliers can have one of the following values: 1x, 2x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 150x, 200x, 250x, 500x

 Whenever at least one of the special Skull or Kraken symbols land on a spin, all 3 lives refill. The feature ends after three spins in a row without any of the special symbols landing.

 At the end of the feature, the multiplier value above each reel will be added to all Cursed Area positions on the respective reels.
The sum of all multipliers in Cursed Areas will then be multiplied by the bet to determine the awarded win.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all other symbols in the paytable.

 The Cursed Chest symbol substitutes for all other symbols in the paytable.

respins.how_it_works:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus game keeps the mechanics of the PLAY WITH SAFIRE bonus. In addition, a 3x3 Colossal Diamond symbol is guaranteed to land during the first free spin.

 Diamond symbols can have the following Multiplier values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins 
 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins 

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 FS symbols cannot land during Dandy Respins.

wilds.name: COLOSSAL DIAMOND SYMBOLS
wilds.behavior:
If 4 or more Diamond symbols land in a square formation of 2x2, 3x3, 4x4 or 5x5 they merge to form a Colossal Diamond symbol. When the Colossal Diamond is formed, any Diamond Multiplier values are added together and applied to the Colossal Diamond symbol. Colossal Diamond symbols act as a Wild symbol, substituting for all symbols in the paytable. The Multiplier value of the Colossal Diamond symbol is applied to each winning combination that the Colossal Diamond symbol is part of.

 A Colossal Diamond symbol can grow if additional Diamond symbols land around the existing Colossal Diamond in such a way that they collectively form a larger square formation, for example growing from 2x2 to 3x3.

scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus game keeps the mechanics of the PLAY WITH SAFIRE bonus. In addition, a 3x3 Colossal Diamond symbol is guaranteed to land during the first free spin.

 Diamond symbols can have the following Multiplier values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins 
 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins 

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 FS symbols cannot land during Dandy Respins.

multipliers.name: BOLT SYMBOLS
multipliers.behavior:
A Bolt symbol is activated when it lands within a 3x3 square formation surrounding a Diamond symbol or Colossal Diamond symbol. When activated, the Bolt symbol applies a Multiplier value or increases the Multiplier values of all Diamond symbols and Colossal Diamonds inside the surrounding 3x3 square formation before any wins are rewarded. When the wins have been awarded, the Bolt symbol spins out from the grid along the regular paying symbols. Bolt symbols can land during regular spins and Dandy Respins. Bolt symbols add one of the following Additive Multiplier values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x.

 An Epic Bolt symbol will activate when it lands while there is any Diamond on the grid. An activated Epic Bolt symbol applies a Multiplier value or increases the Multiplier values of all Diamond symbols and Colossal Diamond symbols on the grid before any wins have been handled. When the wins have been handled, the Epic Bolt symbol spins out from the grid along the regular paying symbols. Epic Bolt symbols can land during regular spins and Dandy Respins. The Epic Bolt symbol adds one of the following Additive Multiplier values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x.

 Only 1 Bolt and Epic Bolt can land during the same spin. When a Bolt and Epic Bolt symbol land and activate during the same spin, the Bolt symbol will activate before the Epic Bolt symbol.

modes.name: DIAMOND SYMBOLS AND DANDY RESPINS
modes.trigger: When the Diamond symbol has landed, it will trigger a Dandy Respin after all winning combinations have been handled.
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Sticky/persistent state described in effects
modes.effects:
When a Diamond symbol lands, it acts as a Wild, substituting for all symbols in the paytable. Diamond symbols can also land with an Additive Multiplier. Multipliers can have the following values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x.

 When the Diamond symbol has landed, it will trigger a Dandy Respin after all winning combinations have been handled. During a Dandy Respin, all Diamond symbols are Sticky, meaning that they keep their grid position and Multiplier value, while new symbols spin in. Every time a new Diamond symbol lands, another Dandy Respin is awarded. The Respin sequence continues until no new Diamond symbols land or there are no more available positions on the grid.

 Wins are awarded after every Dandy Respin. When a Diamond Multiplier participates in a winning combination, the value of the win is multiplied by the Diamond’s Multiplier value. If more than one Diamond symbol is part of the same winning combination, their Multiplier values are added together before being applied to the win.

 Danny symbols only expand upward, to the top of the grid. Danny symbols that do not expand are counted as a single Wild symbol. Only one Danny symbol can land on a reel at a time. Expanded Dollar-Reels count as Wilds on every position the expanded symbol covers.

 If a Dollar-Reel expands through a Wild symbol a multiplier is applied to the entire Dollar-Reel. Dollar-Reel Multipliers can have the following values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 200x

 If a winning combination includes more than one Dollar-Reel with a multiplier, the multiplier values will be added together and then applied to the win.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
When Summoning symbols land, their size can be 1x2, 1x3 or 1x4. When Summoning symbols land, they all reveal a different stack of the same paying or Wild symbol. The symbol size determines the number of stacked symbols on each Summoning symbol.

 Summoning symbol size 1x2 reveals 3, 4, 5 or 6 symbol stacks.

 Summoning symbol size 1x3 reveals 5, 6, 7, 8 or 9 symbol stacks.

 Summoning symbol size 1x4 reveals 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11 or 12 symbol stacks.

 If a Wild symbol lands directly above or directly below a Summoning symbol on the same reel, the Summoning symbol will increase in size by expanding to cover that Wild symbol once the grid is settled.

 When Summoning symbols are part of a win, they will stay on the grid as other winning symbols cascade out. The winning Summoning symbols will reveal a new paying or Wild symbol. If subsequent wins occur, the Summoning symbols will reveal a new paying or Wild symbol; this continues until no new wins occur. 

 When there are no more wins, all symbols, including the Summoning symbols, are removed from the grid for the next spin. Summoning symbols can land on reels 2, 3, 4 and 5.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
When a winning combination occurs all symbols of the winning type are marked and removed from the grid after all current wins have been awarded.

 New symbols cascade in to replace the removed symbols, potentially creating new wins and additional cascades.

wilds.name: WILD MULTIPLIERS
wilds.behavior:
The Wild symbols substitute for all other symbols in the paytable. There are two Wild symbol variants, a blue Wild and a red Wild. The blue Wild appears in the base game and in the Rise to Salvation bonus feature. The red Wild appears in the Trial by Hellfire bonus feature. There is no functional difference between the two variants.

 When a Wild symbol appears it may have one of the following multiplier values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x. Wild symbols cannot appear with a multiplier in the Rise to Salvation bonus feature.

 If more than one multiplier is part of the same winning combination, their values are added together before being applied to the win.

wilds.name: WILL OF THE ORDER
wilds.behavior:
When an Order scatter symbol lands it will replace itself and 1 - 9 other symbols with Wild symbols, which may appear with or without multipliers.

 If more than one Order symbol lands at the same time, Will of the Order will be triggered once for each Order symbol.

scatters.name: UNHOLY SUMMONING
scatters.behavior: Any Unholy scatter symbols that land together with at least one winning combination are collected at the top-right corner of the grid and saved for the duration of the round. If 3 Unholy symbols land at the same time, they are immediately collected regardless of any winning combinations.

specials.name: SUPER CASCADE
specials.behavior:
When a winning combination occurs all symbols of the winning type are marked and removed from the grid after all current wins have been awarded.

 New symbols cascade in to replace the removed symbols, potentially creating new wins and additional cascades.

modes.name: TRIAL BY HELLFIRE BONUS FEATURE
modes.effects:
Collect 3 Unholy symbols during the same round in the base game to activate this bonus feature with 10 free spins.

 During the bonus, all winning positions are marked with Hellfire. 

 When an Unholy symbol lands it will activate the Fires of Hell sequence. At the start of this sequence, the Unholy symbol and all symbols on positions marked by Hellfire are replaced with Wild symbols, which may appear with or without multipliers. All Hellfire is then removed.

 The Fires of Hell sequence last until the next cascade. While the Fires of Hell sequence is active, new wins do not create Hellfire.

modes.name: RISE TO SALVATION BONUS FEATURE
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Sticky/persistent state described in effects
modes.effects:
If you collect 3 Unholy symbols during the same round in the base game and an Order symbol is present when the third Unholy symbol is collected, this bonus feature is activated with 10 free spins.

 During the bonus, the symbol drop and cascade direction is reversed so that symbols move upwards instead of downwards.

 This bonus has special Lost Soul symbols. Whenever a Lost Soul lands, it becomes persistent and stays on the reels until the end of the bonus, or until it Ascends.

 Lost Souls move upward together with other cascading symbols to fill the empty spaces left behind by removed wins. When a Lost Soul reaches the top row of the grid, it Ascends and is removed.

 There are two Lost Soul symbol variants, a Global Multiplier Lost Soul and a Cash Prize Lost Soul.

 When the Global Multiplier Lost soul reaches the top row and Ascends, it adds one of the following multiplier values to a global multiplier above the reels: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 25x, 50x, 100x. The global multiplier is applied to all winning combinations.

 When the Cash Prize Lost Soul reaches the top row and Ascends, it awards one of the following cash prizes: 10, 15, 20, 25, 50, 100 or 666 times the bet. Cash prizes are also multiplied by the value of the global multiplier.

 If three non-winning spins occur in a row, 3 - 5 random Low- or High-paying symbols are removed from the grid on the third spin.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Order symbol does not appear in the Trial by Hellfire bonus feature.

 The Unholy symbol does not appear in the Rise to Salvation bonus feature. The Unholy symbol does not appear on reel 1 or 2.

wilds.name: JOKER SYMBOL
wilds.behavior:
The JOKER symbol acts as a Wild in Classic Mode, substituting for all paying symbols in the paytable. Only one JOKER symbol can land at the same time in Classic Mode.

 After it lands and all payline wins have been awarded, the grid flips to Poker Mode and the JOKER symbol transforms into one of four Joker card options:

 Regular Joker 
 Hand Multiplier Joker 
 Global Multiplier Joker 
 Triple Trouble Joker 

 The different Joker card features are explained below.

scatters.name: HIDDEN EPIC BONUS - FOOL’S GOLD
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during Classic Mode in the base game. If a JOKER symbol lands on the same spin, the bonus game will be activated after any Poker Mode wins are awarded.

 This bonus keeps the mechanics of the DEALBREAKER bonus. In addition, a JOKER symbol is guaranteed to land on every spin, triggering Poker Mode!

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in Classic Mode in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins,

 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 FS symbols that land in Classic Mode will transform into a random Joker card if the game enters Poker Mode on the same spin.

multipliers.name: HAND MULTIPLIER JOKER
multipliers.behavior:
This Joker activates before Poker Hand wins are calculated, and awards a Poker Hand Multiplier that is applied on the row where it landed, for one spin. The Poker Hand Multiplier can be one of the following values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, or 10x.

 After the multiplier has been awarded, the Joker transforms into a regular poker card, always picking the best option for the row where it landed.

 If more than one Hand Multiplier Joker lands on the same row, their multipliers will be added together.

multipliers.name: GLOBAL MULTIPLIER JOKER
multipliers.behavior:
This Joker activates before Poker Hand wins are calculated, and awards a Global Multiplier that is applied to all winning Poker Hands on the grid, for one spin. The Global Multiplier can be one of the following values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, or 10x.

 After the multiplier has been awarded, the Joker transforms into a regular poker card, always picking the best option for the row where it landed.

 If a Global Multiplier affects a winning Poker Hand that is also affected by another multiplier, the values will be added together.

collectors.name: TRIPLE TROUBLE JOKER
collectors.behavior:
This Joker has a delayed activation that triggers after Poker Hand wins are calculated.

 Before calculating Poker Hand wins, the Joker transforms into a regular poker card, always picking the best option for the row where it landed.

 Once all Poker Hand wins on the current grid have been awarded, all cards on the grid are collected, shuffled and then the three best possible Poker Hands from all the collected cards are dealt back onto the grid and awarded one by one, in ascending order.

 Non-winning Joker cards on the grid will transform into a random poker card.

expanding_reels.how_it_works:
When a Densho symbol lands, it expands into a Multiplier Reel if the expanded reel would be part of at least one winning combination once expanded.

 Multiplier Reels are wild and substitute for all other paying symbols, and apply a multiplier to each winning combination they are part of. If a winning combination includes more than one Multiplier Reel, their multipliers are added together before being applied to the win. The multiplier value on each Multiplier Reel is determined by the quality of the Densho symbol that created it:

 The possible multiplier values from the Common Densho symbol are: 2x - 10x

 The possible multiplier values from the Rare Densho symbol are: 5x - 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x

 The possible multiplier values from the Legendary Densho symbol are: 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x

 Each reel can land only one Densho symbol at once.

respins.how_it_works:
Land 3 or 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game to trigger one of the bonus games.

 You can also trigger one of the bonuses by collecting FS symbols during respins. If only 1 or 2 FS symbols land on a spin they are collected in the Bonus Meter above the reels if there is at least one Wild Multiplier with 1 or more Vitality. Once the Bonus Meter reaches 3 or 4 collected FS symbols, it will trigger the corresponding bonus game at the end of the round (after any potential respins have been awarded).

wilds.name: WILD MULTIPLIER
wilds.behavior:
The Wild Multiplier symbol substitutes for all other symbols in the paytable and multiplies the value of any winning combination that it is part of. Wild Multipliers can land with one of the following values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 200x.

 If more than one Wild Multiplier is part of the same winning combination, their values are added together before being applied to the win.

 Wild Multipliers may land with up to 3 Vitality, shown on the symbol as red hearts. While a Wild Multiplier has Vitality remaining, it stays sticky on the grid and awards respins. For each respin awarded, 1 Vitality is removed from every Wild Multiplier on the grid. When a Wild Multiplier reaches 0 Vitality, it will be removed on the next spin or respin.

wilds.behavior: When the Heart symbol lands it triggers Aphrodite’s Love and restores 1 - 3 Vitality to all Wild Multipliers on the grid.

wilds.name: ZEUS’S THUNDER
wilds.behavior: When the X symbol lands it activates Zeus’s Thunder and calls down a bolt of lightning that doubles the multiplier value of all Wild Multipliers on the grid!

Once the Bonus Meter reaches 3 or 4 collected FS symbols, it will trigger the corresponding bonus game at the end of the round (after any potential respins have been awarded).

multipliers.behavior:
When a Danny symbol lands, it will expand into a Dollar-Reel if the Danny symbol is part of a LootLine win, or the expanded Dollar-Reel is part of a LootLine win.

 Danny symbols only expand upward, to the top of the grid, after all regular wins are collected. Once expanded, the Dollar-Reel and every position it covers can be part of a LootLine.  For example, a winning LootLine that consists of 1 Dollar-Reel symbol, 1 Donny symbol and 1 Dollar-Reel symbol with the values x3, 15x and x2 will have a final payout of 3+15*2=36x.

wilds.name: GOOEY GUNS AND GOOEY WILDS
wilds.behavior:
When a Gooey Gun symbol lands it shoots Gooey Wild symbols to the left on the same row, as far as the edge of the grid. The Gooey Gun symbol then transforms into a Gooey Wild! Gooey Gun symbols can also land with a multiplier value from one of the following values: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x.

 Gooey Wild symbols are wild symbols that substitute for all other symbols in the paytable. All Gooey Wild symbols fired or transformed from a Gooey Gun take on the same multiplier value as the Gun, and the multiplier values are added together into one value which is applied to all connected Gooey Wilds on the same row.

 When at least one Gooey Wild with a multiplier is part of a winning payline, that multiplier is applied to the win. If a winning payline includes Gooey Wild multipliers from more than one row of connected Gooey Wild symbols, their multiplier values are added together before being applied to the win.

 The multiplier value from a row of connected Gooey Wild symbols cannot be applied more than once per winning combination, regardless of how many winning symbols are on that row.

wilds.name: GIFT BOXES
wilds.behavior:
Gift Boxes are wild multipliers. There are three different kinds of Gift Boxes: Common Gift Box, Rare Gift Box and Epic Gift Box. The Common Gift Boxes always show their multiplier value. The Rare and Epic Gift Boxes only reveal their multiplier value when they are part of a winning combination. All winning combinations that a Gift Box is part of will be multiplied with the shown value. If more than one Gift Box is part of the same winline, their multipliers are first added together and then applied to the win.

 The Common Gift Box can have the values: Wild, 2x, 3x, 4x

 The Rare Gift Box can have the values: 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x

 The Epic Gift Box can have the values: 25x, 50x, 75x, 100x, 150x, 200x

 If you land 3 Gift Boxes of any kind on the same spin the Gift Bonanza bonus game is awarded!. The placement and the value of the triggering Gift Boxes is carried over into the bonus.

wilds.name: EXPANDING WILD REELS
wilds.behavior:
When a Treasure Chest symbol lands it will expand into a Wild Reel if it would be part of a winning combination once expanded.

 Expanded Wild Reels cover the entire reel and will show one of the following characters: Octopus, Mermaid or Ocean King! Each character has a different multiplier tier with increasing multiplier values!

 The Octopus can have one of the following multiplier values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x

 The Mermaid can have one of the following multiplier values: 10x, 15x, 20x

 The Ocean King can have one of the following multiplier values: 25x, 50x, 100x, 200x

 The landed character’s multiplier is applied across the entire Wild Reel and affects any winning combinations that it is part of.

 All Wild Reel positions count as Wild symbols and substitute for all other symbols in the paytable.

 If more than one Wild Reels are part of the same winning combination, their multipliers are added together before being applied to the win.

 Treasure Chest symbols can land on any reel, but only 1 Treasure Chest symbol can land on a reel at a time.

modes.name: DEEP BLUE BONUS GAME
modes.trigger: Land 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate the DEEP BLUE bonus game with 10 free spins.
modes.sticky_or_persistent_state: Sticky/persistent state described in effects
modes.effects:
Land 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate the DEEP BLUE bonus game with 10 free spins.

 This bonus maintains the mechanics of the base game with the addition that a landed Treasure Chest symbol always expands and becomes a Wild Reel regardless of whether it is part of a win or not.

 Furthermore, expanded Wild Reels will reveal 0 - 3 lives and are sticky into the next spin as long as they have lives remaining. 1 life is removed from each sticky Wild Reel at the beginning of each spin. At the start of each spin, sticky Wild Reels will receive a new random multiplier from any of the three character tiers.

 If there is at least one Wild Reel with 1 or more lives remaining on the last free spin of the bonus game, the Last Chance feature will activate! Last Chance will award free respins and keep the bonus game active until no Wild Reels have any lives left.

 During Last Chance, additional Treasure Chest symbols can land on the grid and turn into new expanded Wild Reels with or without lives. If the Wild Reel reveals lives, the number of lives will never exceed the number of lives of any existing Wild Reels.

 The bonus game ends when there are no spins and no Wild Reels with lives remaining.

 Landing additional FS symbols during the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award 2 additional spins,

 3 FS symbols award 4 additional spins.

wilds.name: WILD EYEBALL SYMBOLS
wilds.behavior:
When an EyeBall symbol lands, it can only land on the 4th row of the grid. Once the grid has settled, all EyeBall symbols shoot in 1 of 3 directions: straight up, diagonally left, or diagonally right. EyeBall symbols activate in order from left to right.

 When an EyeBall shoots, every paying symbol along its path transforms into a Wild symbol. These transformed symbols can remain Wild or reveal an Additive Multiplier value. Wild symbols substitute for all symbols in the paytable. Multiplier values revealed on Wild symbols can be: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 200x.

 If an EyeBall symbol hits an existing Wild symbol, that Wild symbol gains a Multiplier value. If an EyeBall symbol hits a Wild symbol with a Multiplier, the Multiplier value of that Wild will increase by adding a new Multiplier value to the existing Wild Multiplier. Multiplier values added to Wild symbols can be: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 200x.

 Activated EyeBall symbols transform into Wild symbols. If more than 1 Wild Multiplier symbol is part of the same winning combination, the values are first added together before being applied to the win.

wilds.name: ENERGY FIELDS
wilds.behavior:
There are 3 Energy Fields located on the left, top, and right edges of the grid. If an EyeBall symbol activates and hits an Energy Field, the EyeBall will bounce off the Energy Field and continue in another direction at the same angle. The EyeBall symbol will continue to transform paying symbols in its path into Wild symbols.

 When an EyeBall symbol hits a Energy Field straight on, the EyeBall will bounce back the same way it came from, adding Multiplier values to the transformed Wild symbols. If an EyeBall hits an EyeBall symbol, it adds a Multiplier value.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
Charred Land symbols are Wild multipliers that have 3 charges when they land.

 After a Charred Land symbol is part of one or more wins it loses a charge before the next cascade. Each time that a symbol cascade occurs, every Charred Land currently on the grid has its multiplier value increased by 1.

 If more than one Charred Land is part of a win, their values are added together before being applied to the win.

 Charred Land multipliers can land with one of the following values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x.

multipliers.name: DRAGON SYMBOLS AND DRAGONFIRE
multipliers.behavior:
Dragon symbols on the grid will activate once the grid is fully settled and no more wins occur, breathing Dragonfire in a cross-pattern from its position. All regular paying symbols hit by the Dragonfire will be removed from the grid. If Dragonfire hits any Charred Land symbols, the charges on those Charred Land symbols will be refilled.

 Dragon symbols come in two different colors: Red and Gold.

 Gold Dragon symbols will have a multiplier from one of the following values: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10.

 Whenever a Charred Land symbol is hit by Dragonfire from a Gold Dragon, its multiplier is multiplied by the value on the Gold Dragon.

modes.effects:
Land 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate a DRAGON’S LAIR bonus feature with 10 free spins.

 In this feature, all Charred Land multipliers are persistent between free spins as long as they have charges left.

 Landing additional FS scatter symbols during the feature awards extra free spins:

 3 FS symbols awards 4 additional spins.

modes.name: THE HATCHERY BONUS GAME
modes.trigger: Land 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate a THE HATCHERY bonus feature with 10 free spins.
modes.effects:
Land 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate a THE HATCHERY bonus feature with 10 free spins.

 During this feature, only non-paying symbols, Dragon Egg and Dragon symbols appear.

 Dragon Eggs are cash prizes based on your current bet. They are collected when hit by Dragonfire.

 Any non-paying symbols hit by Dragonfire will be removed and trigger a cascade.

 There are 3 types of Dragon Eggs: Green, Red, and Golden Eggs.

 Green Eggs can have the following values: 1, 2, 5, 10.

 Red Eggs can have the following values: 20, 30, 40.

 Golden Eggs can have the following values: 50, 100, 200.

 Whenever a Dragon Egg symbol is hit by Dragonfire from a Gold Dragon, the egg’s value is multiplied by the value on the Gold Dragon.

 The value of each collected Dragon Egg will be multiplied by your bet to determine the final awarded amount.

 Landing additional FS scatter symbols during the feature awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols awards 2 additional spins.

 3 FS symbols awards 4 additional spins.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 Charred Land symbols substitute for all symbols in the paytable.

 Dragon Egg symbols only appear in THE HATCHERY bonus game.

wilds.name: DROP SYMBOL
wilds.behavior:
When one or more Drop symbols land, the Drop mechanic will activate after any winning combinations on the initial grid have been awarded.

 Each Drop symbol will fall downward and out of the grid and remove all symbols below it. Any symbols above the Drop symbol will fall to the bottom of the reel.

 The empty spaces on each reel will then be filled with the same randomly chosen symbol. In the base game, this symbol will be chosen from any of the paying symbols or the Wild symbol.

 If the new symbols create a winning combination, that win will be awarded. If a winning combination created by the new symbols could also include symbols which have already been a part of a winning combination before the Drop mechanic activated, those symbols will also be included in the new winning combination.

wilds.name: DROP SPINS BONUS
wilds.behavior:
Land 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to trigger this feature with 10 free spins.

 This bonus starts with all paying symbols and the Wild symbol in the pool of possible symbols that can be chosen by the Drop mechanic.

 Land the FS symbol in the feature to reveal extra free spins and possibly get an UPGRADE that removes some symbols from the Drop mechanic pool. Each landed FS symbol can award +1, +2 or +3 extra free spins. When revealing an UPGRADE, between 1 to 10 (at most all remaining) paying symbols will be removed from the choice pool. The Wild symbol can never be removed from the pool.

wilds.name: HIGH DROP SPINS BONUS
wilds.behavior:
Land 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to trigger this feature with 10 free spins.

 This bonus starts with only high-paying symbols and the Wild symbol in the pool of possible symbols that can be chosen by the Drop mechanic. 

 Land the FS symbol in the feature to reveal extra free spins and possibly get an UPGRADE that removes some symbols from the Drop mechanic pool. Each landed FS symbol can award +1, +2 or +3 extra free spins. When revealing an UPGRADE, between 1 to 5 (at most all remaining) paying symbols will be removed from the choice pool. The Wild symbol can never be removed from the pool.

wilds.name: WILD DROP SPINS BONUS
wilds.behavior:
Land 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to trigger this feature with 10 free spins. 

 This bonus has the Wild symbol as the only possible choice for the Drop mechanic! 

 Land the FS symbol in the feature to reveal extra free spins. Each landed FS symbol can award +1, +2 or +3 extra free spins.

WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined lines on adjacent reels from left to right, starting with the leftmost reel. The number of possible lines in this game is 19. Please consult the paytable for the number of each symbol

wilds.name: DUELREELS™
wilds.behavior:
When a VS symbol lands it will expand into a wild DuelReel if it would be part of a winning combination once expanded.

 After expanding, the DuelReel will cover the entire reel and a duel will take place on the reel. Each DuelReel will have two multipliers, connected to the duelists The Outlaw and The Sheriff. The surviving duelists multiplier will be applied across the entire reel and affects any winning combinations that includes the DuelReel.

 All expanded DuelReel positions count as WILD symbols

 The possible multiplier values for DuelReels™ are: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 75x, 100x, 200x

 If more than one DuelReels™ are part of the same winning combination, their multipliers are added together before being applied to the win.

 Only 1 VS symbol can land on a reel at a time.

wilds.name: THE OUTLAW FEATURE
wilds.behavior:
When an Outlaw symbol lands, it will expand into a full wild Outlaw reel and show a revolver with 1-6 bullets in its chambers. The number of bullets in the revolver represents the number of Wild symbols that the Outlaw will shoot onto the grid.

 If more than one Outlaw is on the grid at the same time, they cannot shoot multiple Wild symbols onto the same positions on the grid, nor can they shoot at each other. A maximum of 2 Outlaw symbols can appear on one spin, and only 1 Outlaw symbol can land on a reel at a time.

 Each Outlaw reel will also have a multiplier that can be one of the following values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 75x, 100x, 200x.

 The multiplier affects any winning combination that includes the Outlaw reel. If more than one Outlaw reels are part of the same winning combination, their multipliers are added together before being applied to the win.

wilds.name: WILD WILD WEST
wilds.behavior:
Land 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate the WILD WILD WEST bonus feature with 10 free spins.

 This bonus feature maintains the mechanics of the base game with an increased chance of getting high-value multipliers on DuelReels™ and Outlaw reels! There is also an increased chance of landing VS symbols and Outlaw symbols!

 Landing additional FS symbols during the bonus awards extra free spins: 

 2 FS symbols award 2 additional spins,

 3 FS symbols award 4 additional spins.

wilds.name: DUSK ‘TIL DAWN
wilds.behavior:
Land 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate the DUSK ‘TIL DAWN bonus feature with 10 free spins.

 This bonus feature offers the chance of earning 4 DuelSpins with guaranteed VS symbols! You unlock each DuelSpin by landing Outlaw symbols and shooting a full revolver of 6 Wild symbols onto the grid.

 Each DuelSpin is awarded immediately after the free spin where you unlocked it and does not count towards your number of free spins in the bonus. No more than 2 DuelSpins can be unlocked in one spin; if more than one are unlocked in the same spin, they are awarded in sequence before proceeding to the next free spin.

 Each subsequent DuelSpin awards more guaranteed VS symbols:

 The first DuelSpin guarantees at least 2 VS symbols;

 The second DuelSpin guarantees at least 3 VS symbols;

 The third DuelSpin guarantees at least 4 VS symbols;

 The fourth DuelSpin guarantees that 5 VS symbols land!

 Each unlocked DuelSpin also awards 3 additional free spins.

 VS symbols do not appear in this bonus except during DuelSpins.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable.

 A VS symbol and an Outlaw symbol can never land at the same time.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works: When a winning combination occurs, all regular paying symbols of the type that were part of the winning combination are removed from the grid, and new symbols drop down to fill the empty spaces.

wilds.name: BLESSING BAR
wilds.behavior:
A Blessing Bar is located outside the grid which awards Wild symbols and Multipliers on those Wild symbols when full. When a winning combination lands on the grid, the Blessing Bar will start to fill. An 8-symbol win is needed to fill the Blessing Bar the first time. Then the amount of winning symbols needed will increase by +2 symbols each time you fill the Bar. The Blessing Bar will reset between spins if only partially filled.

 When the Blessing Bar is full, it activates and then resets. When activated, the Blessing Bar awards Wild symbols with a Multiplier value each. On the first activation, the Blessing Bar will start with an award of 3 Wild symbols.

 The Wild symbol substitutes for all symbols in the paytable. When a Wild symbol is part of a win, the Multiplier value is added to all wins connected to that Wild symbol. If more than one Wild symbol with a Multiplier is part of the same winning combination, the values are added together before being applied to the win.

 When the Blessing Bar activates again the number of Wild symbols or the value of the Multiplier that can be awarded will increase upon each subsequent activation. The Wild symbols can increase by 1 each time and the Multiplier value can increase by adding a random Multiplier value to the existing Multiplier on the Blessing Bar. The Additive Multiplier values added to the Blessing Bar can be 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 250x, 500x.

wilds.name: HIDDEN EPIC BONUS - THE NIGHT COURT
wilds.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus keeps the base game’s mechanics. In addition, the Blessing Bar will stay full throughout the bonus and activate once on every free spin after regular wins have been handled. The awarded Wild symbol will start at 6 and the Multiplier will start at 10x. The awarded Wild or Multiplier value will increase after the Blessing Bar activates on every spin.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 FS symbols cannot land in THE DUSK COURT, THE LUNAR COURT and THE NIGHT COURT bonus.

specials.name: SUPER CASCADES
specials.behavior: When a winning combination occurs, all regular paying symbols of the type that were part of the winning combination are removed from the grid, and new symbols drop down to fill the empty spaces.

modes.name: BONUS GAME - THE DUSK COURT
modes.trigger: landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.
modes.effects:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus keeps the base game’s mechanics, with an increased chance of getting more Wild symbols and higher Multiplier values. wilds.name: DUELREELS™
wilds.behavior:
When a VS or Bounty VS symbol lands, it expands into a DuelReel if part of a winning combination once expanded. Fully expanded DuelReels™ count as Wild reels and substitute for all symbols in the paytable. Once expanded, the DuelReel will cover the entire reel, triggering a Duel between two duelists. Each DuelReel will have 1 Adding Multiplier assigned to each of the 2 duelists.

 When a VS symbol expands, it expands into an Outlaw DuelReel. The Multiplier from the surviving duelists will be applied across that entire DuelReel and is added to all wins connected to that reel. If more than 1 Outlaw DuelReel is part of the same winning combination, their winning Multipliers are added together before being applied to the win.

 The possible Multiplier values for Outlaw DuelReels™ are: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x.

 When a Bounty VS symbol expands, it expands into a Bounty DuelReel with a Duel between the Bounty Hunter and an Outlaw. If the Bounty Hunter wins a Duel, she collects the Multiplier from the Outlaw and combines it with her existing Multiplier, and another Duel is triggered on the same Bounty DuelReel. On the new Duel, the Bounty Hunter will display her combined Multiplier from the previous Duel. This repeats until the Bounty Hunter loses a Duel or after 3 Duels have been played. When the Bounty Hunter loses a Duel, her collected Multiplier is applied to that Bounty DuelReel. The Multiplier values for Bounty DuelReels™ start at 2x.

 Only 1 VS symbol or 1 Bounty VS symbol can land on a reel at a time.

multipliers.name: WIN TO WIN
multipliers.behavior:
After a winning combination occurs, the squares behind the winning symbols will be highlighted as Divine Squares.

 If there is a Hand of Zeus symbol on the grid it will activate any Divine Squares after all wins have been completed. Activated Divine Squares reveal either Bronze, Silver or Gold Coins, and have a chance to show Vessel of Wealth or Zap of Zeus symbols.

 All Coins are cash prizes that are paid as a multiple of your bet.

 Bronze Coins can have the following values: 0,2x, 0,5x, 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x 
 Silver Coins can have the following values: 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x 
 Gold Coins can have the following values: 25x, 50x, 100x, 250x, 500x 

 After all symbols have been revealed, any Zap of Zeus symbols will activate and multiply all Coins or existing Vessel of Wealth symbols on adjacent squares with one of the following values: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10.

 Vessel of Wealth symbols will activate after all Coins have been revealed and all Zap of Zeus symbols have been activated. Vessel of Wealth symbols collect the values of all Coins and other Vessel of Wealth symbols and store their total value. Vessel of Wealth symbols activate top-to-bottom, left-to-right.

 After the last Vessel of Wealth on the current grid has activated, all other Divine Squares will activate again to reveal new symbols and the process above repeats.

 Once all reveals and activations have been completed all Coins and Vessel of Wealth symbols will be added together and multiplied with your bet amount to determine the final awarded win.

scatters.name: WICKED NIGHT
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus feature with three lives by landing at least 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 In this feature, only non-paying symbols, Evil Eye symbols and multiplier scatter symbols will appear. Every time an Evil Eye symbol lands it will glance up, right, left or down and collect all the multiplier symbols that cross its gaze. The multiplier symbol values that are collected will be added to the reel multiplier above the reel that they landed on.

 If the gaze of an Evil Eye symbol crosses another Evil Eye symbol, the Evil Eye symbol will reveal a multiplier that will be added to all reel multipliers above each reel. The revealed multiplier can have the same values as the normal adding multipliers described below.

 In this bonus feature, the Evil Eye symbol can land on all reels, and multiple Evil Eye symbols can land on the grid at the same time.

 This feature has 3 refilling lives that reset each time the eye looks at and collects a multiplier. Each life represents one spin. Once all three lives are consumed without a new reset, the feature will end. When the feature ends, all reel multipliers will be added together and multiplied with your bet to determine the final win. 

 The multipliers can have one of the following values:

 Adding multipliers: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x

 Multiplying multipliers: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10

 Multipliers are collected in sequence from the Eye to the edge of the grid.

scatters.name: THE GRAVEYARD
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus feature with 10 free spins by landing at least 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 Throughout this feature, low symbols that have been a part of a win and spread by the Evil Spread mechanic will not appear in future spins. The low symbol indicator above the grid shows which low symbols remain within the feature.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time during the feature awards additional free spins: 

 2 FS symbols award 2 extra spins;

 3 FS symbols award 4 extra spins

multipliers.name: WICKED EPIC DROP™
multipliers.behavior:
The Epic Drop™ feature has a chance to be randomly activated at the start of each spin when playing the base game. When this feature is activated the game transforms into the Wicked Night bonus feature for just one spin. On this spin, at least 3 Evil Eye symbols and 4 multipliers are guaranteed to land, and at least one multiplier will always be collected!

 The Wicked Epic Drop™ does not have any lives and after the wins from the drop have been awarded, the game reverts back to the base game mode and continues as usual…unless you were lucky enough to activate another Epic Drop™!

specials.name: THE EVIL EYE AND THE EVIL SPREAD MECHANIC
specials.behavior:
If the Evil Eye symbol lands under a winning symbol, it will activate the Evil Spread mechanic. The Evil Eye symbol will first mark all the symbols of that win. Then it will rotate to face right or down to indicate the direction of the Evil Spread mechanic. The Evil Spread mechanic will extend the win to the end of the grid in the chosen direction by replacing the marked symbols with the winning symbol. If the Evil Spread mechanic crosses the path of the Evil Eye symbol itself, the Evil Eye symbol will also be replaced. For example: If the direction is “down”, all symbols under the marked win will be replaced with the winning symbol.

 If the Evil Spread mechanic was activated to the right, there is a chance that the mechanic will be activated again in the downward direction. The Evil Eye symbol can only land on reel 3, and only one Evil Eye symbol can land on the grid at the same time. The Evil Eye symbol cannot land on row 1.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works: When a winning combination occurs, all regular paying symbols of the type that were part of the winning combination are removed from the grid, and new ones drop down to fill the empty spaces.

wilds.name: MEDUSA SYMBOLS
wilds.behavior:
Medusa symbols act as a Wild and substitute for all symbols in the paytable. Medusa symbols can be Silver or Gold.

 When a win with low-paying symbols occurs while a Medusa symbol is on the grid, the Medusa symbol will drop to the bottom of the grid and stay until the end of the spin. All other non-Petrified symbols are removed and new ones will drop down to fill the empty spaces. This continues until no further wins occur.

multipliers.name: PETRIFIED SYMBOLS
multipliers.behavior:
When a win with high-paying symbols occurs while a Medusa symbol is on the grid, those symbols are Petrified and drop to the bottom of the grid along with the Medusa symbol. The Petrified and Medusa symbols remain at the bottom while all other symbols are removed and new ones will drop down to fill the empty spaces. If additional wins occur with high-paying symbols, those symbols will also be added to the bottom. This continues until no further wins occur.

 At the end of the spin, all Petrified symbols reveal an Adding Multiplier from the Bronze, Silver, or Gold values below, depending on the high-paying symbols in the win.

 Bronze: 0.2x, 0.5x, 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x

 Silver: 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x

 Gold: 25x, 50x, 100x, 250x, 500x

 After the Petrified Adding Multipliers are revealed, the Medusa symbol displays its own Multiplier. The Silver Medusa symbol shows a multiplier value of x1, x2, x3, or x4, while the Gold Medusa symbol shows x5, x6, x7, x8, x9, x10, or x20. The final win is determined by adding the Petrified values and multiplying the total by the Medusa Multiplier, and then multiplying this total with your bet.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
Land 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate the JUMPING PANDAS bonus feature with 10 free spins.

 The feature keeps all the mechanics of the base game, but the first 5 Wild Panda Multiplier symbols that land become sticky and stay on the reels until the end of the feature. The sticky Pandas will jump to a new random position on each free spin and cascade and get a new Multiplier value on each jump. The Panda Multiplier activates whenever the Panda symbol is a part of a winning combination.

wilds.name: WILD PANDA MULTIPLIERS
wilds.behavior:
The Panda symbol is a Wild Multiplier with the possible values: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10.

 The Panda symbol substitutes for other paying symbols, and will apply their Multipliers to any winning combination that the Panda symbol is a part of. If more than one Panda symbol is part of the same winning combination, the Multipliers will multiply each other, before being applied to the win.

 Landed Wild Panda Multipliers are persistent during the round until they are part of a winning combination. Once a Panda symbol is part of a win, it is removed on the next cascade together with the winning symbols.

wilds.name: NEVER SAY NO TO PANDA! BONUS
wilds.behavior:
Land 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate the NEVER SAY NO TO PANDA! bonus feature with 10 free spins.

 When a Panda symbol is not part of a winning combination, it will be saved in one of the 5 Panda Collector spaces outside the reel. If there are no empty spaces in the Collector when a Panda symbol lands on a non-winning spin, that Panda will not be saved.

 When a win occurs with at least one winning payline, Pandas in the Panda Collector will jump down onto the reels again to randomly selected existing winning positions in a winning combination and apply their Multiplier to any wins they are part of, in the same manner as in the Base Game. Only the number of Pandas that can fit within the existing wins will jump down from the Panda Collector. If there are no more winning positions to fill, the Pandas will be saved in the Panda Collector.

 Since Pandas are Wild symbols, they can create new wins when they have jumped down from the Panda Collector. These wins will also be multiplied by the Multiplier.

 On the last spin of the feature, all saved Pandas that were not part of any win will jump down to randomly selected losing positions on the reels. If they create winning combinations, those wins will be multiplied by the Panda’s Multipliers and then cascade.

wilds.name: SPEAKER SYMBOL
wilds.behavior:
When at least two Speaker symbols land on different reels on the grid, all winning paylines that connect them will be identified and the Speaker Mechanic will activate. During the Speaker Mechanic, all symbols including Wild symbols, FS symbols and the Speaker symbols themselves within the winning paylines will be flipped and replaced with a paying symbol. All symbols will be replaced with the same symbol.

 The Speaker Mechanic will only activate if there are Speaker symbols present on at least two different reels. If two Speaker symbols land on the same reel during a spin that will activate the Speaker Mechanic, they will fill the vertical gap between them with Speaker symbols to create even more winning paylines.

 In the base game, the Speaker Mechanic can only replace symbols with paying symbols.

 If an FS symbol is replaced by another symbol during the Speaker Mechanic, it will still count towards potentially triggering a bonus game.

wilds.behavior:
Land 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate the PUMP UP THE JAM! bonus feature with 10 free spins. In this bonus feature, the mechanics of the base game are more likely to be activated. In this game mode, the Speaker Mechanic also has a chance to replace symbols with wild symbols.

 In this game mode, the Speaker Mechanic also has a chance to replace symbols with wild symbols.

 Landing additional FS scatter symbols during the feature awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols awards 2 additional spins;

 3 FS symbols awards 4 additional spins.

wilds.name: GET YOUR BOOTY ON THE FLOOR! BONUS
wilds.behavior:
Land 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate the GET YOUR BOOTY ON THE FLOOR! bonus feature with 10 free spins. In this bonus feature, the value of the global multiplier has a chance to increase over time. Every time the X symbol lands on the grid, it reveals its multiplier value which is added to the global multiplier.

 The global multiplier is activated when there is a win on the grid, and an X symbol is present on the grid at the same time. When it is activated, the global multiplier will multiply the total win of the current spin.

 In this game mode, the Speaker Mechanic also has a chance to replace symbols with wild symbols.

 Landing additional FS scatter symbols during the feature awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols awards 2 additional spins;

 3 FS symbols awards 4 additional spins.

respins.how_it_works:
Land 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate this bonus game with 10 free spins.

 This bonus game maintains the mechanics of the base game. In addition, the Red and Green teams battle against each other to reach higher Victory Levels.

 Each team starts at Victory Level 3+. Each time a Fist symbol punches an opponent's Fighter or a Wild symbol, the Fist's team earns one Victory Point. For example, the Red team gains one Victory Point when a Red Fist punches a Fighter symbol from the Green team. Each team’s Victory Points are counted in the bars outside the grid.

 When a team has collected three Victory Points, a respin with an Epic Drop™ is awarded and the winning team’s Victory Level increases by one. The number of Fist symbols that are guaranteed to drop in the Epic Drop™ depends on the Victory Level of the team:

 Victory Level 3+: At least 3 Fist symbols of the winning team’s color are guaranteed to land in the Epic Drop™

 Victory Level 4+: At least 4 Fist symbols of the winning team’s color are guaranteed to land in the Epic Drop™ 

 Victory Level 5+: 5 Fist symbols of the winning team’s color are guaranteed to land in the Epic Drop™

 Fists that land during the Epic Drop™ do not count towards increasing the winning team’s Victory Level.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time during the feature awards additional free spins:

 2 FS symbols award 2 extra spins.

 3 FS symbols award 4 extra spins.

wilds.name: WILD FIST REELS
wilds.behavior:
When a Fist symbol activates, it expands into a Wild Fist Reel that starts from the position of the Fist symbol and rises upwards to the top of the reel. Fist symbols only activate if the expanded Wild Reel is part of at least one winning combination once expanded. Wild Fist Reels act as Wild symbols on all positions they cover and substitute for all other paying symbols.

 Fist symbols belong to either the Red team or the Green team, which is indicated by the color of the symbol. If the Fist symbol passes through (“punches”) a Fighter symbol of the opposite team or a Wild symbol, a multiplier will be added to the Wild Fist Reel. This multiplier will be applied to each winning combination it is part of.

 If the Fist symbol expands through multiple Fighter symbols, the multipliers will be added together and then applied to the expanded Wild Fist Reel. If a winning combination includes more than one Wild Fist Reel, their multipliers are added together before being applied to the win.

 The possible multiplier values are: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 200x.

 Only one Fist symbol can land on a reel at a time.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:

respins.how_it_works:
Land 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate this bonus game with 10 free spins.

 In the THROWDOWN! BONUS, the mechanics of the base game are maintained. In addition, the Red and Blue teams battle against each other to increase their Victory Level.

 Each team starts with the Victory Level 3+. Every time a Fist symbol from either team punches a Fighter of the opposing team or a Wild symbol, the Fist's team gains one Victory Point. For example, the Red team gains one Victory Point when a Red Fist punches a Fighter from the Blue team.

 When the team has collected three Victory Points, a respin with the Epic Drop™ is awarded and the winning team's Victory Level increases by one. The number of Fist symbols that are guaranteed to drop in the Epic Drop™ depends on the Victory Level of the team:

 Victory Level 3+: At least 3 Fist symbols of the winning team's color are guaranteed to land in the Epic Drop™

 Victory Level 4+: At least 4 Fist symbols of the winning team's color are guaranteed to land in the Epic Drop™ 

 Victory Level 5+: 5 Fist symbols of the winning team's color are guaranteed to land in the Epic Drop™

 Fists that land during the Epic Drop™ do not count towards increasing the winning team's Victory Level.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins

 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins

expanding_reels.how_it_works:
When a Fist symbol activates, it expands into a Wild Reel that starts from the position of the Fist symbol and rises to the top of the reel. Fist symbols only activate if the expanded reel would be part of at least one winning combination once expanded.

 Fist Wild Reels are Wild and substitute for all other paying symbols. Fist symbols belong to either the Red team or the Blue team, which is indicated by the color of the symbol. If the Fist symbol passes through ("punches") a Fighter symbol of the opposite team or a Wild symbol, a multiplier will be added to the Wild Reel. This multiplier will be applied to each winning combination it is part of.

 If the Fist symbol has traveled through multiple Fighter symbols, the multipliers will be added together and then applied to the win. If a winning combination includes more than one Fist Wild Reel, their multipliers are added together before being applied to the win.

 The possible multiplier values are: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 100x, 200x.

 Each reel can land only one Fist symbol at once.

 MEGAMULTIPLIER™ SYMBOLS

 The max win is instantly awarded when 3 Megamultiplier™ symbols land at the same time. Megamultiplier™ symbols can land during base game.

 They can also land during BONUSHUNT FEATURESPINS™.

 Megamultiplier™ symbols can land on reels 1, 3 and 5.

wilds.name: WILDS
wilds.behavior:
Every time a WILD symbol lands on a reel in the base game, the wind feature is triggered. The wind will blow in a random direction and all WILD symbols on the grid will spread in that direction. The WILD symbols will spread the same number of positions as there are WILD symbols on the grid. Example: A grid contains two WILD symbols. modes.name: FREE SPINS
modes.trigger: land three or more butterfly free spins symbols, the game launches into the free spin mode.
modes.effects:
If you land three or more butterfly free spins symbols, the game launches into the free spin mode. This feature starts off with 3 free spins. The free spins will continue until you get three non-winning spins in a row. Every time you get a winning symbol, the number of free spins is reset to 3. The meter next to the grid displays the number of remaining spins.

 Each reel has a number and a progress bar above it. Every time a butterfly or a bumblebee symbol lands it will affect the current reel total above that reel.

 At the end of the free spin feature, the total win will equal the sum of all displayed numbers multiplied with the current bet level (this applies if the fixed prize win is not won). All symbols affecting the multipliers are applied in the order left to right, top to bottom.

 The symbols appearing in the free spins mode are described below:

 The blue butterfly symbol will add the number revealed to the current reel’s multiplier. The possible multipliers are +1, +2, +5, +10, +25, +50, +100.

 Every time the green butterfly symbol appears, it will multiply the number shown above the current reel with the factor revealed. The possible multipliers are x2, x3, x5, x10, x25, x50.

 Bumblebees add one step on the progress bar above each reel. To win the high fixed prize of {jackpotwinvalue} you need to fill up the progress bar on each reel - it takes 3 times on all reels, 15 in total to trigger the high fixed prize win.

 The tornado symbol affects all symbols that have landed on the reels in that spin so that their values are added to all reels. This applies to both multipliers and max win progress.

 These symbols are non-winning.

wilds.name: BANANA SPLIT? NO, BANANA SPREAD!
wilds.behavior:
Spreading Banana symbols can point either to the left, or up.

 When a Spreading Banana lands, additional Spreading Banana symbols will spread from that symbol either left or up depending on the direction the original Spreading Banana symbol points. When it points up, Spreading Banana symbols will spread upward on the same reel to the edge of the grid, and when it points left Spreading Banana symbols will spread to the left on the same row to the edge of the grid.

 The spreading will only occur if the Spreading Bananas would be part of at least one winning combination after spreading.

 All Spreading Banana symbols are wild multipliers that substitute for the other symbols in the paytable. Each Spreading Banana symbol will reveal its multiplier value after landing, before spreading. All Spreading Bananas created by spreading will take on the same multiplier value as the Spreading Banana symbol they originate from. If two Spreading Banana symbols spread over the same grid position, their multiplier values will be added together on that position.

 Spreading Banana symbols can have one of the following multiplier values: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 75x, 100x

 When at least one Spreading Banana symbol is part of a winning payline, the multiplier is applied to the win. If a winning payline includes more than one Spreading Banana symbol, the multiplier values are added together before being applied to the win.

wilds.name: BANANA BLITZ!
wilds.behavior:
Land 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to activate the BANANA BLITZ! bonus game with 10 free spins. 

 This bonus game features Sticky Banana symbols and the Go Bananas symbol.

 Landed Sticky Banana symbols stay on the grid until the end of the bonus. Each Sticky Banana symbol is given a new random multiplier on each spin from one of the following values: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 75x, 100x

 If there is a minimum of one Sticky Banana symbol on the grid and you land a Go Bananas symbol, the Go Bananas mechanic will activate immediately.

 When activated, the Go Bananas symbol will reveal a value between 3 - 10. This number represents the number of Banana copies that will be created from each of the Sticky Banana symbols currently on the grid.

 Example: If there are 3 Sticky Banana symbols on the grid when landing a Go Bananas symbol that reveals a value of 3, 9 copied Bananas will be added to the grid. Some Bananas can land on top of each other, reducing the actual number of Bananas that appear on the grid.

 Copied Bananas are wild multipliers symbols that will appear in random positions on the grid and substitute for other symbols in the paytable. A copied Banana symbol will always have the same multiplier value as the Sticky Banana symbol it was copied from. If two copied Banana symbols land on the same position, their multiplier values will be added together.

 Copied Bananas are removed from the grid on the next spin. Go Bananas symbols are also removed on the next spin.

 Landing additional FS symbols during the bonus awards extra free spins: 

 2 FS symbols award 2 additional spins,

 3 FS symbols award 4 additional spins.

expanding_reels.how_it_works:
The DuelReels™ mechanic transforms the entire reel to a wild multiplier! Landing the VS symbol triggers an expanding reel with a duel between two fruits with multipliers. The reel only expands if it would create, or be part of, at least one winning combination when expanded.

 The fruit that wins the duel will apply its multiplier to the whole reel. The whole reel becomes wild and the value of any connecting winlines is multiplied by the reel multiplier. If more than one wild reel is part of a winning combination, their multipliers will first be added together and then applied to the win.

 The possible multiplier values are: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x, 75x, 100x

multipliers.name: Multipliers
multipliers.behavior:
This game features a MULTIPLIER symbol that will multiply your wins. Every MULTIPLIER symbol that lands on the reels will reveal a value. The value shown will be added to the total multiplier displayed in the logotype. The possible multipliers are 1x, 2x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x and a staggering 100x! After every win, the win amount will be multiplied by the current factor displayed in the logotype.

 Look out for the 3 different colored symbols:

 Light blue

 Reveals one of the following multipliers: 1x, 2x or 5x

 Dark blue

 Reveals one of the following multipliers: 10x, 15x or 20x

 Striped blue

 Reveals one of the following multipliers: 25x, 50x or 100x

 At the start of each base game spin, the multiplier is reset to 1.

modes.effects:

 4 FREE SPIN symbols will give you 10 spins.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
Jumping Wild Multipliers jump to a new position after each cascade allowing for new possibilities to win. There are two kinds of multipliers, Normal and Epic.

 Normal Jumping Wild Multipliers start with a multiplier value of 1x and increase with +1x every time they jump.

 Epic Jumping Wild Multipliers start with a multiplier value of 10x and increase with +10x every time they jump.

 A maximum of 4 Jumping Wild Multipliers can be on the grid at any given time.

wilds.name: FROMAGE FRENZY
wilds.behavior:
Activate this bonus game with 8 free spins by landing at least 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 You start the bonus with 2 persistent Jumping Wild Multipliers of either type! Wild Multipliers values reset during each new spin. 

 This bonus includes a Cheese Meter and your goal is to collect the cheese to fill the meter. 

 The Cheese Meter is located at the top of the grid and shows the progress of collected cheese. Cheese symbols are collected when they are removed from the grid. When the meter is full you will upgrade to the next free spins bonus and be rewarded additional free spins.

 From this bonus you will be upgraded to TAKE IT CHEESY bonus and be rewarded 5 additional spins.

 Landing additional FS scatter symbols at the same time during the bonus game awards additional free spins:

 3+ FS scatter symbols award 5 extra spins.

wilds.name: TAKE IT CHEESY
wilds.behavior:
Activate this bonus game with 10 free spins by landing at least 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 You start the bonus with 3 persistent Jumping Wild Multipliers of either type! Wild Multipliers values reset during each new spin. 

 This bonus also includes the Cheese Meter (see FROMAGE FRENZY for details).

 From this bonus you will be upgraded to LIFE'S SO GOUDA bonus and be rewarded 5 additional spins.

 Landing additional FS scatter symbols at the same time during the bonus game awards additional free spins:

 3+ FS scatter symbols award 5 extra spins.

wilds.name: LIFE'S SO GOUDA
wilds.behavior:
Activate this bonus game with 12 free spins by landing at least 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 You start the bonus with 4 persistent Jumping Wild Multipliers where at least one is guaranteed to be an Epic Jumping Wild Multiplier!

 In this bonus, Wild Multipliers values do NOT reset during each new spin.

 Landing additional FS scatter symbols at the same time during the bonus game awards additional free spins:

 3+ FS scatter symbols award 5 extra spins.

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Jumping Wild Multiplier symbols substitutes for all symbols in the paytable.

wilds.name: HUNTING SEASON
wilds.behavior:
When a Hunting Season symbol lands on the grid, a Hunt is triggered after all regular wins are handled. One target is located above each reel. Five shots are fired from left to right that will either hit or miss the target.

 Any Animal symbols on the reels that are hit are transformed into Coin or Trap symbols. Animal symbols display between 1 and 4 Stars, which determines the minimum currency revealed.

 1 Star Animal symbols grant a minimum of Bronze Coins.

 2 Star Animal symbols grant a minimum of Silver Coins.

 3 Star Animal symbols grant a minimum of Gold Coins.

 4 Star Animal symbols transform into a Trap symbol with a minimum value equal to Gold Coins.

 All Coins are awarded as a multiple of your bet amount.

 Bronze Coins have the following starting values: 0.2x, 0.4x, 0.6x, 0.8x, 1x

 Silver Coins have the following starting values: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x

 Gold Coins have the following starting values: 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x

 Diamond Coins have the following starting values: 100x, 150x, 250x, 500x

 During a Hunt, when a 4 Star Animal symbol appears on a reel that is shot, that symbol will transform into a Trap symbol with a value. Trap symbols collect the values of all Coins and other Trap symbols and add the collected values to its existing Trap value. All collected symbols retain their original values when collected by a Trap symbol. Trap symbols activate top to bottom, left to right. The final win is the total value of all Coins and Trap symbols.

 If there is a Wild symbol on a reel that has been shot, that Wild symbol receives a Multiplier value. After all Coins and Trap symbols are collected each Wild symbol with a Multiplier multiplies between 1 and 5 Coin and Trap symbols. Wild symbols with Multipliers activate top to bottom, left to right. Wild symbols with Multipliers can have the following Multiplicative Multiplier values: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10, x20.

 Only one Hunting Season symbol can land on the grid at a time.

scatters.name: HIDDEN EPIC BONUS - TROPHY HUNTING
scatters.behavior:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 5 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus keeps the mechanics from the FREE BIRD bonus. In addition, a Hunting Season symbol is guaranteed to land on every free spin.

 FS symbols cannot land in this bonus.

modes.name: BONUS GAME - COUNTRY STRONG
modes.trigger: landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.
modes.effects:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 3 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus keeps the base game's mechanics with an increased chance of landing Hunting Season symbols!

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins

 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins

modes.name: BONUS GAME - FREE BIRD
modes.trigger: landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.
modes.effects:
Activate this bonus with 10 free spins by landing 4 FS scatter symbols at the same time during the base game.

 This bonus keeps the base game's mechanics. In addition, when an Animal symbol is part of a regular win, that Animal symbol will gain another Star. The added Star takes effect immediately and is progressive, lasting for the rest of the bonus or until the Animal symbol gains another Star. 4 Star Animal symbols gain the Trap symbol transformation during a Hunt. Each Animal symbol can only gain one Star per spin.

 Landing additional FS symbols at the same time in the bonus awards extra free spins:

 2 FS symbols award +2 free spins

 3 FS symbols award +4 free spins

win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 Land 5 or more connecting symbols of the same kind anywhere on the grid to get a winning combination.

 After every win the winning symbols are removed and new ones drop in. This continues until there are no more new wins on the reels.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
Symbol wins make that symbol type enter a charged state and begin to glow. Charged symbol types are also shown in the “charge bar” display above the grid. Symbols retain their charged state until the end of the current spin.

 The Epic Gem scatter symbol may drop in on cascades after winning symbols are removed and will activate after the grid has settled, when no more wins or cascades occur. When the Epic Gem activates, all charged symbols on the grid are transformed into the highest paying charged symbol!

 All charged symbols are then absorbed by the Epic Gem and counted as if they were one winning cluster. The Epic Gem itself counts as 4 symbols, so that it will always be able to create a minimum win of 5 symbols so long as there is at least one charged symbol on the grid. Once all charged symbols are absorbed, the Epic Gem explodes and triggers another cascade!

 Symbols do not have a charged state during the Gem Hoarder game mode.

wilds.name: Gem Hoarder
wilds.behavior:
Land 3 Gem Bag scatter symbols at the same time in the base game to trigger this bonus game, which has 5 refilling free spins. Landing 3 Gem Bag symbols at the same time during the feature refills all 5 free spins!

 This feature has a progressive global multiplier that increases whenever winning symbols are removed! The multiplier value is increased by an amount equal to the number of removed symbols. Any winning cluster that connects to the special X-Gem symbol is multiplied by the global multiplier! If more than one X-Gem symbol connect to the same winning cluster, the global multiplier will be applied once for each connecting X-Gem symbol!

 SPECIAL SYMBOLS

 The Epic Gem does not appear in the Gem Hoarder game mode.

 The X-Gem symbol counts as a wild symbol, substituting all other paying symbols, and appears only in the Gem Hoarder game mode.
