multipliers.name: WIN TO WIN
multipliers.behavior:
After a winning combination occurs, the squares behind the winning symbols will be highlighted as Divine Squares.

 If there is a Hand of Zeus symbol on the grid it will activate any Divine Squares after all wins have been completed. Activated Divine Squares reveal either Bronze, Silver or Gold Coins, and have a chance to show Vessel of Wealth or Zap of Zeus symbols.

 All Coins are cash prizes that are paid as a multiple of your bet.

 Bronze Coins can have the following values: 0.2x, 0.5x, 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x

 Silver Coins can have the following values: 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x

 Gold Coins can have the following values: 25x, 50x, 100x, 250x, 500x

 After all symbols have been revealed, any Zap of Zeus symbols will activate and multiply all Coins or existing Vessel of Wealth symbols on adjacent squares with one of the following values: x2, x3, x4, x5, x10

 Vessel of Wealth symbols will activate after all Coins have been revealed and all Zap of Zeus symbols have been activated. Vessel of Wealth symbols collect the values of all Coins and other Vessel of Wealth symbols and store their total value. Vessel of Wealth symbols activate top-to-bottom, left-to-right.

 After the last Vessel of Wealth on the current grid has activated, all other Divine Squares will activate again to reveal new symbols and the process above repeats.

 Once all reveals and activations have been completed all Coins and Vessel of Wealth symbols will be added together and multiplied with your bet amount to determine the final awarded win.

evidence.quote_or_excerpt:
## Reel Area
5x5 reel setup with bottom row locked and a Ritual Bar beneath the bottom row. Bottom locked row is filled with Wild symbols and each level progression unlocks a Wild symbol starting from the left

Winning combinations will be destroyed and remaining symbols will tumble down, allowing the new symbols to fall in.

## Ritual Bar
There are 5 levels of progressions. The Ritual Bar resets for each level up. Exceeding collection will be carried over.

- Level 1: 20
- Level 2: 30
- Level 3: 40
- Level 4: 60
- Level 5: 80

Landing the Scatter symbols and winning combinations of medium and high paying symbols advances the Ritual bar.

- Medium paying symbol = +1 per winning symbol
- High paying symbol = +2 per winning symbol
- Scatter symbol = +10 per Scatter symbol

Each level removes the lowest paying symbols and also converts medium symbols to high paying symbols.

Ritual bar resets for every new game round.

## Candle Spins
Reaching a new level of the Ritual Bar awards +2 Candle Spins till level 4, +6 Free Spins when advancing to Reign of Terror Spins.

Before any new level, any plausible wins pay out before progressing to the next level.

Enter the dark and forbidden world of an abandoned cathedral in Blood & Shadow. Nolimit City invites you to join Shadow Girl as she performs a demonic ritual for eternal youth. 4-row high Wild that always nudges into fully visible, where every nudge increases the Wild multiplier with +1.

Winning

## Collapsing Mine
Each spin begins with 3 active rows and for each collapse, an additional row becomes active, up to 6 rows. A new collapse can be triggered by a winning combination, xBomb Wild explosion or a Wild Mining feature.\nWinning symbols are paid out and removed before triggering the next collapse, which will, in turn, make all symbols fall downwards, leaving the empty position for new symbols to drop down to.

## Lucky Wagon Spins
3, 4 or 5 bonus symbols will trigger the Lucky Wagons Spins feature with 2, 3 or 4 rows of the reel area open initially. The feature starts with 3 spins and will reset to 3 spins every time a coin lands in the reel area. All coin values are valued times (x) the active bet.\nDuring the Lucky Wagon Spins feature, the top row will reveal enhancers for each spin - Coin values, Multipliers, Dynamites, Bag, Chest or the Dwarf. An enhancer is activated when a coin lands on the reel below the enhancer.

An extra row is added and the reel area becomes 5x5.

Gameplay and features from "The Ride" are the same, but with a guaranteed Scatter symbol on reel 5.

## Fire Frames & Fire Reels
Fire Frames: Randomly, 1 to 13 positions on the reels in the main game may turn into a Fire Frame. Any symbol that lands in a Fire Frame will split into 2 parts.

Fire Reels: Randomly, 1 to 5 reels in the game may turn into a Fire Reel. Any symbol that lands in a Fire Reel will split into 3 parts.

## Dead Patients
Gets activated when there are 2 Dead Patient symbols.

It reveals one of the Patient symbols with a random multiplier: x5, x10, x15, x30, x50, x100, x200, x500, x1,000, x9,999.

Multiplier value reflects the symbol count on that reel.

## Enhancer Cells
Enhancer Cells are located at the bottom of reels 2, 3, and 4. The more Fire Frames that appear, the more Enhancer Cells get activated:

- 4 Fire Frames activate the Reel 2 Enhancer Cell.
- 6 Fire Frames activate Reel 2 and Reel 4 Enhancer Cells.
- 8 Fire Frames activate all 3 Enhancer Cells (on reels 2, 3, and 4).

A Fire Reel is considered as 2 or 3 Fire Frames for the Enhancer Cell activation, depending on the size of the reel it’s on.

PUNK ROCKER xWAYS®
Punk Rocker xWays® is here and packs a
punch with its arsenal of features packed
into noisy and up-tempo slot driven by pure
adrenaline.

Reintroducing the reel expanding feature xWays® as
well as scatter triggered features - Riot Respin, Anarchy
Freespin and the hard to get Civil War Freespins.

This game also unveils an updated mobile friendly bet
panel, customised to an even enhanced future of mobile
first game development, accompanied of the new player
facing Promo Tool interface.

Punk Rocker xWays® is available with two dual RTP setup
at 96.11% and 94.18% (DX1).
 GAME SHEET




Game Features
Punk Rocker doesn’t say sorry to anyone.
A volatile slot with multiple high paying
features - all triggered by scatters - to bring
you a exciting and fun reel experience.

Punk Rocker xWays® initially starts at 243 win ways,
but

## xWays® Mystery Symbol
A mystery symbol that holds 2 to 4 symbols that expands the reels, up to 6 symbols high. Punk characters may be super-expanded up to 20 symbols high, for massive wins!\nxWays® always expand to 4 high in Freespins.

## Molotov Wilds
Wilds that substitutes for any symbol except the scatter, that expands upwards on the reels for massive hits.

## Riot Respin
The main game feature, that triggers on two scatters, which allows for an explosive respin with locked Molotov Wilds and a 6th reel that is unlocked for at least 729 win ways.

## Anarchy Freespins
Bring on the mayhem with an unlocked 6th reel over the course of 8 Anarchy Freespins triggered by 3 scatters. The Freespins all scatters becomes Jumping Wild throughout the bonus round, where the Wilds may be enhanced by the subway train above the ordinary reel set.

## Civil War Freespins
Chaos deluxe! 8 Civil War Freespins - triggered by 4 scatters - on a minimum of 729 win ways where all 4 scatters becomes Jumping Wilds. Experience Big Win after Big win....

## Nolimit Bonus - Feature Buy functionality
Nolimit Bonus - allows the players to buy directly into\nthe Freespin. Choose to buy Buffalo Horde and Prair

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
TUMBLE FEATURE
 The TUMBLE FEATURE means that after every spin, winning combinations are paid and all winning symbols
 disappear. The remaining symbols fall to the bottom of the screen and the empty positions are replaced with new
 symbols coming from above. New symbols are of the same size as the initial spin result, before tumbles.
 Tumbling will continue until no more winning combinations appear as a result of a tumble.
 All wins are added to the player's balance after all the tumbles resulted from a base spin have been played.

respins.how_it_works:
Only the highest win is paid per winning combination on the same pay way.
 When winning on multiple pay ways, all wins are added to the total win.
 Free spins and Respin wins are added to the pay way win.
 All wins are multiplied by base bet.
 All values are expressed as actual wins in coins.
 Free spins and Respin win is awarded to the player after the round completes.
 Free spins and Respin total win in the history contains the whole win of the cycle.

collectors.name: MONEY
collectors.behavior:
This is the LEVEL UP COIN symbol.
  All LEVEL UP COIN symbols that hit are collected in a meter. The first time 3 of them are collected, the round goes to
 level 2, 3 additional free spins are awarded and the lowest WILD multiplier is removed from the possible multipliers
 until the end of the round. The second time 3 of them are collected, the round goes to level 3, 3 additional free spins
 are awarded and the next lowest WILD multiplier is also removed from the possible multipliers until the end of the
 round. The third time 3 of them are collected, the round goes to level 4, 3 additional free spins are awarded and the
 next lowest WILD multiplier is also removed from the possible multipliers until the end of the round. After level 4,
 every time 3 more LEVEL UP COIN symbols are collected, 3 additional free spins are awarded.
 If the round was triggered with only SUPER SCATTER symbols, no regular SCATTER symbols in the combination,
 minimum 3, the triggered FREE SPINS round will be a MAX FREE SPINS feature.
 If the round is a MAX FREE SPINS feature, there are no options to choose from before the round starts and instead the
round starts with 35 free spins and 100x WILD multiplier for the round. There is no LEVEL UP mechanic during this feature
 and for every 3 LEVEL UP COINS collected, 3 additional free spins are awarded.
 Special reels are in play during the FREE SPINS features.

features.name: Tumble Feature
features.effects:
The TUMBLE FEATURE means that after every spin, winning combinations are paid and all winning symbols
 disappear. The remaining symbols fall to the bottom of the screen and the empty positions are replaced with new
 symbols coming from above. New symbols are of the same size as the initial spin result, before tumbles.
 Tumbling will continue until no more winning combinations appear as a result of a tumble.
 All wins are added to the player's balance after all the tumbles resulted from a base spin have been played.

 WILD MULTIPLIER
 Whenever at least a WILD symbol hits and it's part of a winning combination, a random multiplier is applied to
 all winning combinations using WILD during base spins and tumbles. In the base game, possible multiplier
 values are: 1x, 2x, 3x, 5x, 8x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 30x, 40x or 100x.

CONNECT & COLLECT FEATURE
 These are the CONNECT & COLLECT symbols. Randomly, they can carry a random money value.
 Possible values are: 0.4x, 0.6x, 0.8x, 1x, 1.2x, 1.6x, 2x, 2.4x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 8x, 10x, 12x or 50x total
 bet. It can appear on any position on reels 1 to 5, on non-special positions.
 Hit adjacent CONNECT & COLLECT symbols, from left to right, starting from the leftmost reel, touching each other
 horizontally or vertically, to win the values on CONNECT & COLLECT symbols or until the chain of symbols reaches
 one of the special positions on reel 3 or reel 6 to win the award from the reached special position.
 In the base game and FREE SPINS the special positions on reel 3 and reel 6 the following symbols can hit randomly:
 RESPINS - Can hit only on the special positions on reel 3. Whenever it hits it triggers a respin round. The round
 has 5 respins. During the round, all the CONNECT & COLLECT symbols hit in the initial spin remain in place and
 all other positions on reels 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5 respin. Any CONNECT & COLLECT symbols that hit during respins also
 remain in place until there are no more respins left. If all special positions are linked the RESPINS end. After the
 round, the game pays for all connections.
 MONEY VALUE - Whenever it hits it takes a random money value from a pre-defined set. Whenever it is
 reached by a connection chain its value is awarded. Possible values are 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 8x, 10x, 12x, 20x,
 30x, 40x, 50x, 60x, 80x, 100x, 120x

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
TUMBLE FEATURE
 The TUMBLE FEATURE means that after every spin, winning combinations are paid and all
 winning symbols disappear. The remaining symbols fall towards the bottom of the screen and
 the empty positions are replaced with new symbols coming from above.
 Tumbling will continue until no more winning combinations appear as a result of a tumble.
 All wins are added to the player's balance after all of the tumbles resulted from a base spin have been played.
 This is the WILD symbol and substitutes for all symbols for the
 purpose of winning combinations except for SCATTER.
 It can appear on reel 3 during the base game and on reels 2, 3 and 4 during the FREE SPINS feature.
 The WILD symbol is inactive and does not substitute unless it hits or reaches the bottom, marked row.
 Above the marked row it is shown as inactive and it becomes active once it reaches the bottom row.

WIN MULTIPLIER FEATURE
 Every spin starts with a multiplier of 1x. Every 10 symbols that explode during tumbles or are exploded by a
 SCATTER add +1x to the win multiplier. The multiplier that WILD symbols carry is also added to the win multiplier
 when a WILD symbol reaches the bottom marked row. The current win multiplier applies to the winning
 combinations as they happen.

scatters.name: SCATTER
scatters.behavior:
This is the SCATTER symbol. It can appear on all reels.
 Whenever the SCATTER symbol hits or reaches the bottom, marked row it explodes along with all
 symbols immediately adjacent to it horizontally, vertically and diagonally. Symbols exploded like this
 are considered winning combinations and pay for how many they are according to their paytable.

scatters.name: SCATTER
scatters.behavior:
FREE SPINS
Hit 3 or more SCATTER symbols across a base game spin and all tumbles resulted from it to trigger the FREE SPINS
 feature and win 7 free spins plus an additional 3 for each SCATTER symbol beyond the 3rd.
 The amount of symbols hitting on each reel during the FREE SPINS round always starts with 3 and
 after every spin it might randomly increase by 1 on a random reel, up to maximum 5 on a reel. Those
 reels will then stay at that size until the end of the round.
 All increases of the win multiplier achieved during any free spin persist throughout the round.
 Any SCATTER symbol that hits or reaches the bottom, marked reel during the round, awards 1 additional free spin.
 The WILD symbol in the FREE SPINS feature can carry a random multiplier of 1x, 2x, 3x, 5x, 10x, 25x, 50x or 100x.
 Special reels are in play during the feature.

 symbols immediately adjacent to it horizontally, vertically and diagonally. Symbols exploded like this

 combinations as they happen.

 The MONEY RESPIN feature starts after all win combinations for the base game are paid.
 The normal symbols fade away and only the MONEY symbols that triggered the feature remain.
 The normal reels are replaced with special reels containing only MONEY symbols and empty spaces.
 You start with a number of respins equal to the number of the MONEY symbols that triggered the feature.

 The round continues until respins are finished or all positions on the screen are filled with MONEY symbols.

 middle reel. Filling the middle reel with MONEY symbols during the round does not expand the grid.

The free spins round is triggered for landing two scatters and plays like the
colossal symbol feature, with 5 lives being gained initially and these
reducing each time a spin that doesn’t create a win inclusive of the
colossal symbol occurs. This allows additional opportunities to grow the
colossal symbol and increase its multiplier throughout the free spins round!
 Game Information
• 4x6 – screen size, with colossal reels
• 10 symbols:
 • 8 Regular symbols: 4 high and 4 low symbols
 • 1 Wild
 • 1 Scatter
• Lines description
 • 25-win lines
 • 25/40(ante) bet multiplier
 • Left-to-Right
 • Only one highest winner paid per pay line
• 1 set of reels:
 • 0 - base set
• Scatter
 • Pays
 • Appears on reels 1 and 6
 • Trigger Free Game
• Wild
 • Pays
 • It substitutes for all symbols except Scatter.
 • Appears on all reels
• Max winning in points
 • 50,000c
 Respin Feature
• The winning spin (regular or scatters’ win) triggers the respin.
• The respins continue until losing spin. The progress resets after a loss.
• Each win increases the level. The max level is 6, all the following spins
 are played on 6th level.
• Respins have 6 levels:
 • 1 level – colossal reel with symbols 2x2
 • 2 level – colossal reel 3x3
 • 3 level – colossal reel 4x4, win multiplier – x2
 • 4 level – colossal reel 4x4, win multiplier – x3
 • 5 level – colossal reel 4x4, win multiplier – x5
 • 6 level – colossal reel 4x4, win multiplier – x10
• Colossal reels appear on middle 4 reels at random positions

features.name: Ante Bet
features.effects:
• Before every spin, the player can choose to pay extra credits for the spin.
• The cost to the player is 40 credits instead of 25.
• It will give the player an extra life during respins.
• If the base spin is losing, the extra life is not applied.
• A life from ante bet goes away first and it can’t be refilled.
• If the extra life isn’t spent and free spins are triggered, the player will get 6
 lives.
• FS re-trigger refill lives to 5 only.

Purchase
• Before every base spin, the player can choose to buy the Free games
 feature.
• The player will get 5 lives
• The cost to the player is 60x the bet.

Bonus Boost
• Bonus Boost is tied to the Free Spins feature activation.

Win limit
• Game has max win limit for one round – 2000 x TB.

 MONEY RESPIN FEATURE
 The MONEY RESPIN FEATURE starts after all win combinations for the lines are paid.

 The normal symbols fade away and only the symbols that triggered the feature remain.
 The normal reels are replaced with special reels containing only symbols and empty spaces.

You start with 3 respins. All symbols that hit after each respin remain on the screen until the end of the round.
 Every time at least one symbol hits, the number of respins is reset to 3.

 The round continues until respins are finished or all positions on the screen are filled with symbols.

 When the MONEY RESPIN feature is complete, the values of all symbols are added and the
 game pays the total amount.

 If at the end of the round all the positions on the screen are filled with one random feature is triggered:
 MULTIPLIER - A multiplier of 2x, 3x, 5x, 8x or 10x is applied to the total win of the respin round.
 WHEEL OF FORTUNE - A wheel of fortune spins awarding one more prize to the total win of the respin
 round. Possible prizes, as multiplier of total bet, are: 18x,28x, 58x, 88x, 108x, 128x, 188x, 288x, 388x or

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
TUMBLE FEATURE
 The TUMBLE FEATURE means that after every spin, winning combinations are paid and all winning symbols
 disappear. The remaining symbols fall to the bottom of the screen and the empty positions are replaced with new
 symbols coming from above. New symbols are of the same size as the initial spin result, before tumbles.
 Tumbling will continue until no more winning combinations appear as a result of a tumble.
 All wins are added to the player's balance after all the tumbles resulted from a base spin have been played.
 SCATTER symbols does not explode and remain on the screen until all tumbles resulted from the same spin end.

scatters.name: SCATTER

TUMBLE FEATURE
 The TUMBLE FEATURE means that after every spin, winning combinations are paid and all winning
 symbols disappear. The remaining symbols fall to the bottom of the screen and the empty positions are

respins.how_it_works:
MONEY SYMBOLS AS WIN MULTIPLIERS
Whenever exactly 3 MONEY symbols hit either together or through multiple tumbles their values transform into win
 multipliers that add together and apply to the win of all subsequent tumbles in that cycle. MONEY symbols that hit
 after the 3rd will also have their value transformed into win multipliers, adding to the total win multiplier.
 When exactly 3 MONEY symbols hit as the initial result of a spin, before any tumble, if that result has no win, the
values on those MONEY symbols transform into multipliers, they are added together, set on the side, and the game
 respins all symbols on the screen until at least one winning combination hits. All wins resulting from this will be
multiplied by the previously collected win multiplier. During these respins and subsequent tumbles, special reels are
 in play that do not contain any MONEY symbols.

respins.how_it_works:
MONEY SYMBOL
 These are the MONEY symbols. At every spin, the MONEY symbols take a
 random money value which can be won during the FREE SPINS feature.
 Possible values are: 0.2x, 0.5x, 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 50x,
 200x, 250x, 333x, 500x or 1000x total bet.
 Randomly, after a base game spin there is a chance that the values of the MONEY symbols on the screen are
collected and awarded. When that happens, a random multiplier of 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 10x, 20x, 30x, 40x or 50x will be
 awarded and applied to the total value collected from the MONEY symbols.
 FREE SPINS
 Hit 3 or more SCATTER symbols to trigger the FREE SPINS feature and get 10 free spins.
 Hitting 4 or 5 SCATTERS will start the subsequent pick bonus with one or two
 boot items respectively already revealed.
 In the base game whenever 2 SCATTER symbols hit without a third, there is a chance for another one
 to be brought onto the screen by a random feature:
 - Randomly, if the SCATTERS on the screen can move down one position without leaving the reel area, a respin is
 triggered where the reels with SCATTERS move one position down and the reels without SCATTERS respin.
 - Also randomly, a crocodile can appear and change one symbol on the screen into a SCATTER.
 Before the round starts, pick objects to reveal modifiers that will apply to the subsequent FREE SPINS round.
 Pick objects until you reveal a boot which ends the bonus and starts the FREE SPINS round with the modifiers

features.name: Ante Bet
features.effects:
The player has the option to select the bet multiplier. Depending on the selected bet, the game behaves differently.
 The possible values are:
 Bet multiplier 15x - the chance to win the FREE SPINS round naturally is higher. More SCATTER symbols are
 present on the reels. The BUY FREE SPINS feature is disabled.
 Bet multiplier 10x - Normal play.

features.name: Buy Free Spins
features.effects:
The FREE SPINS round can be instantly triggered from the base game by buying it for 100x current total bet.
 When buying the FREE SPINS round, on the triggering spin 3, 4 or 5 SCATTERS can hit randomly.

respins.how_it_works:
FREE SPINS
 Hit 3, 4 or 5 SCATTER symbols to trigger the FREE SPINS feature and win 10, 15 or 20 free spins respectively.
 In the base game whenever 2 SCATTER symbols hit without a third, there is a chance for another one
 to be brought onto the screen by a random feature:
 - Randomly, if the SCATTERS on the screen can move down one position without leaving the reel area, a respin is
 triggered where the reels with SCATTERS move one position down and the reels without SCATTERS respin.
 - Also randomly, one more SCATTER can appear on the screen in a random position, after the initial spin result.
 Before the round starts, pick a card from 12 possible cards to reveal the type of FREE SPINS round won.
If a BONUS card is revealed, a regular FREE SPINS round is triggered. If a SECRETS OF THE GOLDEN LAKE card is
 revealed, the GOLDEN LAKE FREE SPINS feature is triggered.
 During the regular FREE SPINS feature each FISHERMAN WILD symbol also collects all
 the values from MONEY symbols on the screen.
 All the FISHERMAN WILD symbols that hit during the feature are collected until the end of the round.
Every 4th FISHERMAN WILD symbol collected retriggers the feature, awards 10 more free spins and the multiplier for
 MONEY symbol collection increases to 2x for the second level, 3x for the third level and 10x for the fourth level.
 After the fourth level, the feature cannot be retriggered anymore.

 spin, MONEY symbols can appear in random positions.
 Randomly, when there are MONEY symbols on the screen but no FISHERMAN WILD symbols, at the end of a free
 spin, a hook will appear pulling a random reel up to bring FISHERMAN WILD symbols onto the screen.

features.name: Ante Bet
features.effects:
The player has the option to select the bet multiplier. Depending on the selected bet, the game behaves differently. The
 possible values are:
 Bet multiplier 15x - the chance to win the FREE SPINS round naturally is higher. More SCATTER symbols are present
 on the reels. The BUY FREE SPINS feature is disabled.
 Bet multiplier 10x - Normal play.
 When playing with ante bet on, there is a chance for 3 SCATTERS to be added in random positions on the screen
at the end of a spin or respin resulted from 2 SCATTERS hitting without a third. These SCATTERS win the FREE SPINS
 feature but the spin result does not pay for lines.

features.name: Buy Free Spins
features.effects:
The FREE SPINS round can be instantly triggered from the base game by buying it.
 There are two options to buy the FREE SPINS:
 Pay 100x total bet to trigger the FREE SPINS feature. When buying the FREE SPINS feature, before the round starts,
 choose a card from 12 possible cards to get the regular FREE SPINS or the GOLDEN LAKE FREE SPINS.
 Pay 270x total bet to trigger the GOLDEN LAKE FREE SPINS feature. When buying this feature, there is no option to
 pick a card before the round starts, and the GOLDEN LAKE FREE SPINS is triggered directly.

 1666x, 2500x or 5000x total bet.

The lake may be frozen over but wins can still be caught in Bigger Bass Blizzard Christmas Catch™
The slot is played across 5x4 reels which sees iconic returning symbols have a winter makeover as rods,
reels and now snowmobile symbols fill the board. These are joined by scatters with three or more
needed to unlock the free spins round.
Here, instant cash prizes are collected by the fisherman wild with four needing to be collected to
progress to the next round, retriggering the spins and awarding an incrementally increasing multiplier.
Celebrate the winter season in style with Bigger Bass Blizzard Christmas Catch™.

 Game Information

Screen size:

 • 4x5 – screen size
 • 12 win lines, pay left-to-right
 • 12/18(ante) bet multiplier

12 Symbols:

 • 9 regular symbols
 • 1 Wild: doesn’t pay
 • 1 Scatter: doesn’t pay, triggers Free Spins
 • 1 Money symbol: pays as regular too

Base Game:

 • Regular symbols pay left-to-right according to the paytable
 • Line of 5 fish pays the sum of cash values.
 • Hook feature: when there is two or more scatters on the screen, there is a chance that a hook will
 drop at the top of the aperture to then move that reel up to award one more scatter
 Game Information
Free Game:

• 3 or more Scatters trigger the Free Spins:
 • 3 Scatters give 10 Free Spins
 • 4 Scatters – 15 Free Spins
 • 5 Scatters – 20 Free Spins
• Fisherman collects the money values from fish
• On every spin we collect the number of landed fishermen: each 4th fisherman triggers
 the next stage and add +10 free spins when other freespins at the current stage have
 been exhausted.
• Free Game has 4 stages:
 • stage 1 – fisherman win multiplier is x1
 • stage 2 – fisherman win multiplier is x2
 • stage 3 – fisherman win multiplier is x3
 • stage 4 – fisherman win multiplier is x10.
• The player can only move 1 stage at a time if the right number of fishermen have been
• collected.
• The maximum number of collected fishermen – 12. More fishermen won’t affect the
 game flow or add additional free spins.
 Game Information
Free Game:

• Dynamite feature: additional feature only during freespins, is that a spin can present
 one or two fishermen with no fish cash symbols in view. The fishermen / fisherman will
 throw a dynamite, and some fruit symbols will explode to be replaced by fish with cash
 values. The cash fish is then collected in the normal way.

• Hook feature: A hook will drop from the top of the reel aperture (1 or 2 hooks) and
 essentially “hook” the reel up to show the fish and fishermen that were hiding below the
 reel aperture. The fishermen now collect the fish cash values as normal.

Ante Game:

• Before every spin, the player can choose to pay extra credits for the spin.
• This will give the player a higher chance to trigger the Free Games Feature
• The cost to the player is 18 credits instead of 12.
• Purchase is unavailable
              THANK YOU

 it gets collected it can randomly trigger the CHEST RESPIN feature with a modifier that upgrades the value of up to
 3 coins currently on the screen with a random amount, at the end of random respins.

 The collection happens at the end of the spin and if the CHEST RESPIN feature is triggered one, two

 CHEST RESPIN FEATURE
 This is the MONEY symbol.
 It can appear only during the RESPIN feature.
 Whenever it hits, it takes a random value from a pre-defined set.
 Possible values are: 0.6x, 0.8x, 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 8x, 10x, 12x, 14x, 16x, 20x, 30x total bet or
 the bonus values of MINI (10x total bet), MINOR (20x total bet) or MAJOR (150x total bet).
 When the round starts, the normal symbols fade away and only blanks
 and MONEY symbols are present on the reelstrips.
 The round starts with the BONUS COIN symbols that were present on the screen when the feature was
 triggered, now transformed into MONEY symbols with the same amounts that they had in the base game.
 The round starts with 3 respins. All MONEY symbols that hit remain on the screen until the end of the round. Every
 time at least one MONEY symbol hits, the number of respins is reset to 3. The round continues until respins are
 finished or all positions on the screen are filled with MONEY symbols.
 If the round was randomly triggered with a GREEN BONUS coin, after every respin, there is a chance that up
 to 3 MONEY symbols currently on the screen get their value upgraded with a random value.
If the round was randomly triggered with a RED BONUS coin, the CHEST RESPIN feature is played on two grids of 5x3
 positions. Each grid starts with the BONUS COIN symbols that were present on the screen when the feature was
 triggered, now transformed into MONEY symbols, with the same amount that they had in the base game.
 If the round was randomly triggered with a PURPLE BONUS coin, the CHEST RESPIN feature starts with 4 respins
 instead of 3 and every MONEY symbol that hits reset the amount of respins back to 4.
 The round ends when there are no more respins left or all positions on the screen are filled with MONEY symbols. If
 all positions are filled with MONEY symbols the GRAND (5000x total bet) is also awarded.
 At the end of the round, the values of all MONEY symbols on the screen are added together and paid.

 MONEY symbols on the grid adjacent to each other horizontally or vertically form groups that have

 Groups of 4, 5 and 6 symbols have a multiplier of x2.
 Groups of 7, 8 and 9 symbols have a multiplier of x3.

 Groups of 19, 20 and 21 symbols have a multiplier of x20.
 Groups of 22 and 23 symbols have a multiplier of x30.
 Groups of 24 symbols have a multiplier of x50.

 If the screen is filled with 25 MONEY symbols the maximum win is awarded.
 The round ends when there are no more respins left or the screen is filled with MONEY symbols. When the
 round ends, the values of all MONEY symbols on the screen are first multiplied by the multiplier of the groups
 they are in, then added together and paid.

wilds.name: WILD
wilds.behavior:
MONEY SYMBOL
 This is the MONEY symbol.
 At every spin the MONEY symbol, takes a random money value.
 The fish paying symbols are also MONEY symbols. At every spin, the fish take
 a random money value which can be won during the FREE SPINS feature.
 FREE SPINS
 Hit 3 or more SCATTER symbols to trigger the FREE SPINS feature.
 5x SCATTER awards 20 free spins
 4x SCATTER awards 15 free spins
 3x SCATTER awards 10 free spins
During the FREE SPINS feature each WILD symbol also collects all the values from MONEY symbols on the screen.
 All the WILD symbols that hit during the feature are collected until the end of the round.
 Every 4th WILD symbol collected, retriggers the feature, awards 10 more free spins and the multiplier for MONEY
symbol collection increases to 2x for the first retrigger, 3x for the second retrigger and 10x for the third retrigger.
 The retriggered spins are played after the previous batch of free spins ends.
 The multiplier applies to the retriggered spins.
 After the third retrigger, the feature cannot be retriggerd anymore.
 Randomly, when there is only 1 WILD symbol on the screen, at the end of a free spin, fish MONEY symbols
 can appear in random positions.
 Special reels are in play during the feature.
 The maximum win amount is limited to 2,100x bet. If the total win of a FREE SPINS ROUND reaches
 2,100x the round immediately ends, win is awarded and all remaining free spins are forfeited

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
TUMBLE FEATURE
 The TUMBLE FEATURE means that after every spin, winning combinations are paid and all winning symbols
 disappear. The remaining symbols fall to the bottom of the screen and the empty positions are replaced with new
 symbols coming from above. New symbols are of the same size as the initial spin result, before tumbles.
 Tumbling will continue until no more winning combinations appear as a result of a tumble.
 All wins are added to the player's balance after all the tumbles resulted from a base spin have been played.

respins.how_it_works:
Feature Gamble
- There are 5 different features that can be awarded
at the start of the round. During the Feature Gamble
you can select to play the currently awarded feature
or gamble to get a higher tier.
- The currently won feature is shown on the screen.
You can choose to gamble in order to have a chance
of getting the next one. If the gamble is succesfull

Expanding Wild:
 • In the base game Wilds only appear on reels 1 and 5.

 • Wins are only multiplied with the value of participating Wild, if both Wilds are part of the win, the multipliers are

Free Spins:
 • Free Spins is triggered when there are expanded wilds on both reel 1 and 5.

 • The multipliers get increased after all wins are added to the spin win and apply for the next spin.
 • Wins are only multiplied with the value of participating Wild. If both Wilds are part of the win, the multipliers are
 summed up and applied.
 • When both multipliers are increased in one spin +1 spin is added to the free spins

wilds.name: WILD
wilds.behavior:
This is the WILD symbol and substitutes for
 . all symbols except for .
 It appears on all reels. It is always added to the screen randomly by
 the SUPER WILD symbol.
 The SUPER WILD symbol shows 8 directions around it. Every time it
 hits, 1 to 8 directions will highlight randomly and WILDS will be added
 to the screen in the highlighted directions, replacing all symbols in
 their path, up to the edge of the grid.
 This is the SCATTER symbol.
 In the base game it appears on reels 1, 3 and 5.
 In the FREE SPINS feature it appears on all reels.
 FREE SPINS FEATURE
 Hit 3 SCATTER symbols to trigger the FREE SPINS feature and get 5 free spins.
 During the round, there is one SUPER WILD symbol guaranteed to be on the screen for the whole duration of the
feature. After every spin, it moves to a random position. Other SUPER WILD symbols cannot hit during the round.
When the round starts, the roaming SUPER WILD symbol gets a random level from 1 to 8. Depending on the level,
 after every free spin, a number of directions are highlighted on it and WILDS are added to the screen in those
 directions, replacing all symbols in their path, up to the edge of the grid.
 For each 2 SCATTER symbols that hit during the round the level of the SUPER WILD will increase by 1
 and 1, 2 or 3 additional free spins are awarded randomly.
 When the SUPER WILD reaches level 8, it cannot level up anymore and no more
 additional free spins can be awarded.
 Special reels are in play during the feature.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
TUMBLE FEATURE
 The TUMBLE FEATURE means that after every spin, winning combinations are paid and all winning symbols
 disappear. The remaining symbols fall to the bottom of the screen and the empty positions are replaced with
 new symbols coming from above. New symbols are of the same size as the initial spin result, before tumbles.
 Tumbling will continue until no more winning combinations appear as a result of a tumble.
 All wins are added to the player's balance after all the tumbles resulted from a base spin have been played.

respins.how_it_works:
HOLD & SPIN
 Whenever 3x or more hit anywhere on the screen it triggers the HOLD & SPIN BONUS.
When the feature starts the initial COIN MONEY symbols remain in place and the symbols on the other reels fade away.
 The grid of symbols remains of the same size as the spin that triggered the feature.
 The value of all initial COIN MONEY SYMBOLS are added to the total win of the round.
 Start with 3 respins. All COIN MONEY SYMBOLS that hit after each respin reset the number of respins back to 3 and
 the value of each COIN MONEY SYMBOL on the screen is added to the total win of the round.

features.effects:
The TUMBLE FEATURE means that after every spin, winning combinations are paid and all winning
 symbols disappear. The remaining symbols fall to the bottom of the screen and the empty positions are
 replaced with new symbols coming from above.
 Tumbling will continue until no more winning combinations or spin features appear as a result of a tumble.
 All wins are added to the player's balance after all of the tumbles and spin features resulted from
 a base spin have been played.

 SPIN FEATURES
 In the base game, at every spin, behind normal symbols special colored markings can appear. Whenever a win
 happens on top of a marked spot it triggers a special spin feature, depending on the color of the mark.

 Blue mark wins NUCLEAR. After all tumbles resulted from the current spin finish, the
 screen is cleared of all symbols and new symbols are brought to the screen.

 Pink mark wins WILD GEM. After all tumbles resulted from the current spin finish, all
 instances of one random symbol present on the screen transform into wild.

 Brown mark awards SQUARES. After all tumbles resulted from the current spin finish,
 random blocks of 2x2 of the same symbol are added in random positions on the screen.

 Red mark awards COLOSSAL SYMBOL. After all tumbles resulted from the current spin
 finish, a random block of 3x3, 4x4 or 5x5 of the same symbol is added in a random position
 on the screen.

 Green mark awards LUCKY WILDS. After all tumbles resulted from the current spin finish, 5
 to 15 WILD symbols are added to the screen in random positions.

 If multiple features are won on the same spin they will play in the following fixed order: NUCLEAR, WILD GEM,
 SQUARES, COLOSSAL SYMBOL and LUCKY WILDS.

 GOLD FEVER PROGRESSIVE FEATURE
 At every spin the number of winning symbols that exploded during tumbles is counted and the GOLD FEVER
 meter fills. When a certain number of symbols is reached the GOLD FEVER feature triggers.
 The meter resets back to zero when no more winning symbol explode as a result of a tumble.
 Collect 114 points from a base game spin with tumbles and spin features to trigger the GOLD FEVER.
 The feature starts after all tumbles and spin modifiers from the current spin end.
 The feature starts at level 1. During the feature at every level, all spin modifiers are guaranteed to be
 played once per level, in order and all wins have a win multiplier starting at 2x.
 Collect enough winning symbols during each level to advance to the next level.

TUMBLE FEATURE
 The TUMBLE FEATURE means that after every spin, winning combinations are paid and all winning symbols
 disappear. The remaining symbols fall to the bottom of the screen and the empty positions are replaced with new
 symbols coming from above. New symbols are of the same size as the inital spin result, before tumbles.
 Tumbling will continue until no more winning combinations appear as a result of a tumble.
 All wins are added to the player's balance after all the tumbles resulted from a base spin have been played.

money symbols that triggered the feature remain. The normal reels are replaced with special reels containing only money symbols an
 empty spaces.
 You start with 4 respins. All money symbols that hit after each respin remain on the screen until the end of the round. Every time at
 least one money symbol hits, the number of respins is reset to 4. The round continues until respins are finished or all positions on t
 screen are filled with money symbols.
 When the MONEY RESPIN feature is complete, the values of all money symbols are added and the game pays the total amount.
 If during the HOLD AND SPIN FEATURE the screen is filled with money symbols, the BIG MONEY WHEEL BONUS is triggered.
 The wheel spins awarding a random prize or a blank. Possible prizes are:
 10x, 20x, 30x, 40x, 50x, 60x, 70x, 80x, 90x, 100x, 200x, 300x, 400x, 500x, 600x, 700x, 800x, 900x, 1000x, 2000x or 5000x.
Whenever a value is awarded, the wheel spins again. Whenever a blank is awarded the round ends. After all wheel spins finish, all pri
 awarded by the HOLD AND SPIN FEATURE and the MONEY WHEEL BONUS are added together and pay.

 fill up the whole reel).

respins.how_it_works:
MYSTERY SYMBOL AND RESPIN
 In the base game, at random spins, one MYSTERY symbol is selected randomly for that spin. After the
 payout of regular symbols, the MYSTERY symbols expand vertically to cover all 3 positions on the reel and
 the game enters a respin mode, keeping the expanded symbols in place and respinning the other reels.
 If more of the current MYSTERY symbols hit after respin, they will also expand, remain in place
 and the game will respin the remaining reels once more.
 Respins end when no more MYSTERY symbols hit or the screen is filled with expanded ones.
 After respins end the MYSTERY symbol pays according to its paytable, on all reels, even on non-adjacent positions.
 Expansion is triggered only if enough symbols for a win are present.

FREE SPINS
 3 or more SCATTER symbols trigger the FREE SPINS round.
 The round starts with 6 free spins.
 The FREE SPINS round has a progressive feature.
 When the round starts, a 1x1 WILD symbol is always present on the screen, moving to a
 random position at every free spin.
All the SCATTER symbols that hit in free spins are collected until the end of the round. Every 3rd SCATTER symbol
collected retriggers the feature, awards a random number of free spins from 1 to 3, and the roaming WILD symbol
 increases in size progressively, to 2x2, 3x3, 4x4 and 5x5.
 After the 4th retrigger, the feature cannot be retriggered anymore.
 If the feature was triggered with 5 SCATTER symbols, the round starts with 2 SCATTERS already collected.
 If the feature was triggered with 4 SCATTER symbols, the round starts with 1 SCATTER already collected.
 Special reels are in play during the FREE SPINS round.

Game Information
Base Game:

 • Mystery Scatter (Book)
 • Acts both as Scatter and Wild
 • Different pay tables for Scatter behavior and Wild behavior
 • Appears on all reels

 • Reels set is selected randomly each spin. Two reels don’t have Book symbols.

Free Game:
 • When Free Game starts player selects type of Mystery Symbol – fixed or changing
 • Fixed Mystery Symbol is selected once for all Free Game
 • Changing Mystery Symbol is selected every free spin
 • Mystery Symbol is selected randomly without player choice
 Game Information
Free Game:

• Expanding Symbol ( Mystery symbol)

 • Each free spin one symbol is Mystery Symbol
 • Appears on all reels
 • Expands to cover the whole reel
 • Scatter can not be selected for expanding
 • It pays all 10 lines. Number of symbols before expanding define paytable.
 • Special symbol should expand after all the other wins not involving this symbol are awarded.
 Expanding symbol does not pay with normal wins, even if x3 exist on a payline. Expanding
 symbol only pays when expanding.
 • To award a win the special symbols do not have to be consecutive. This means if only three
 of a kind is needed for the specific symbol, if there is a symbol on the first, fourth and a
 symbol on the fifth reel, they expand to cover their respective reels there is still a three of a
 kind awarded on all 10 winlines. The symbol will only expand if a win for it is going to be
 awarded.
 • If Mystery Symbol will not produce a win it doesn’t expand
 • Three or more Scatters add 10 additional free spins
               THANK YOU

Another exciting chapter is ready to be unleashed in Kingdom of The Dead™.

Played across 5×3 reels, this Egyptian-themed slot features ancient symbols, including scarabs, the deity of the
underworld, Anubis, and famed Pharaohs as symbols that must form a matching combination across the slot’s 10 pay
lines to award a win.

These are MONEY symbols, they appear on reels 3, 4, 5 and 6.
 At each spin, MONEY symbols take a random value from a pre-defined set or a SILVER, GOLD or PLATINUM fixed
 jackpot prize.
 WILD RESPIN AND COLLECTION FEATURE
Whenever a WILD symbol hits on reel 1 along with a WILD symbol on reel 2, the game has a random chance to extend
 the screen to 3x6, 3x3x4x4x4 or 3x3x4x4x4x4 for the current spin. When available, reel 6 contains only
 MONEY symbols.
 After winning combinations are paid, all MONEY symbols present on the screen are locked in place and reels
 3, 4 and 5 respin to award new symbols.
 After respin, the values of all MONEY symbols that are adjacent to the WILD symbols on reels 1 and 2,
 forming a left-to-right payway, are collected and the total amount is awarded.
 The possible values for MONEY symbols are:
 Direct money award of: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 8x, 10x, 20x, 40x, 50x, 100x, 200x, 400x or 500x total bet.
 Jackpot values are: SILVER, GOLD and PLATINUM. SILVER jackpot value is 50x total bet. GOLD jackpot
 value is 250x total bet. PLATINUM jackpot value is 10,000x total bet.
 COVERALL
 Whenever a WILD symbol hits on reel 1 along with a WILD symbol on reel 2 and reels 3, 4, 5 and 6 (if available) are
 covered with MONEY symbols at the end of the spin, the total value of MONEY symbols on the screen is paid once,
 then paid once again.
 FREE SPINS

 If the round was randomly triggered with a GREEN BONUS coin, after every respin, there is a chance that up

RESPIN FEATURE
 Randomly, at any spin, the RESPIN feature can trigger. When this happens, a random paying symbol is
 selected and the reels spin and stop with only that symbol, WILD symbols if any and blanks.
 After this, the reels will respin and if new symbols of the same type or WILD symbols are added to the grid,
 they stay on the screen and a new respin is triggered.
Respins end either when there are no more symbols of the randomly chosen type hitting after a respin or when the
 screen is completely filled with the chosen symbol.
At the end of the respin, if the screen is filled with the chosen symbol all winning combinations are multiplied by a
 random multiplier of x5, x10, x15 or x25.

features.name: Tumble Feature
features.effects:
The TUMBLE FEATURE means that after every spin, winning combinations are paid and all winning symbols
disappear. The remaining symbols fall to the bottom of the screen and the empty positions are replaced with new
 symbols coming from above. New symbols are of the same size as the initial spin result, before tumbles.
 Tumbling will continue until no more winning combinations appear as a result of a tumble.
 All wins are added to the player's balance after all the tumbles resulted from a base spin have been played.

 WILD MULTIPLIER
Whenever a WILD symbol hits it has a random multiplier of x2 or x3. The multiplier applies to the win of the current
 tumble and all subsequent tumbles and it gets collected in a meter. Whenever more WILDS hit during the tumble
 sequence the collected value is multiplied by the value of the new ones.
 The total multiplier value is reset to x1 at the end of all tumbles in a spin.

cascades_or_tumbles.how_it_works:
WINNING SYMBOLS TUMBLE
 After every spin, all symbols from all winning combinations and all SCATTERS lock on the screen and
 non winning symbols disappear. All remaining symbols fall to the bottom and empty positions are
 replaced with new symbols coming from above.
 If more symbols of the same type or SCATTERS are added to existing winning combinations they will also remain
 on the screen and tumbling will continue.
 Tumbling ends when there are no new symbols added to the existing winning combinations.
 All wins are added to the players balance after all the tumbles have ended.
At every spin a random multiplier appears on top of each reel. Whenever a reel is filled with winning symbols at the
 end of a tumbling sequence, the multiplier from that reel is applied to the win of all winning combinations on the
 screen, except for SCATTER pays. When more multipliers apply their values add to each other.
 Possible multipliers are: 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x, 8x, 9x, 10x, 15x, 20x, 25x, 30x, 40x, 50x, 75x or 100x.

TUMBLE FEATURE
 The TUMBLE FEATURE means that after every spin, winning combinations are paid and all winning

 In the base game randomly, at any spin there is a chance that one of the following features will hit:
 WILD RESPIN
 If 4 or more WILD symbols hit, after paying the win the game goes into a free respin mode.
 The WILDS remain on the screen and move to a random position while the rest of the symbols respin.
 The game pays all winning combinations after each respin.
 If more WILDS hit after the respin, one more respin is awarded.
 The feature ends when no more WILDS hit after a respin.
 SHIFTING STACKED WILDS
 This is the SHIFTING STACKED WILD symbol.
 It appears on reels 2, 3 and 4.

 When the spin stops the SHIFTING STACKED WILDS are brought fully into
 the screen to cover all position on their reel. For each position moved a
 multiplier is increased by 1x for each SHIFTING STACKED WILD.
 After all are moved fully into the screen, winning combinations
 are paid, multiplied by the sum of all multipliers.

 Randomly in a spin that results in no win the Kraken can come into the
 screen and change the symbols to an outcome of 20x to 60x total bet win.
 Randomly after a spin 3 BONUS symbols can appear on the screen as the
 result of an explosion awarding the FREE SPINS feature.

 The FREE SPINS FEATURE is awarded when 4 or more SCATTER symbols hit anywhere on the screen.
 The round starts with 15 free spins.
 During the FREE SPINS round, whenever a MULTIPLIER symbol hits and the spin results in a win, the MULTIPLIER

 Hit 3 BONUS symbols to trigger the WHEEL WITH FREE GAMES BONUS.

 When the round starts a WHEEL OF FORTUNE appears containing money values expressed as
 multipliers of total bet, GRAND, MAJOR, MINOR, MINI fixed jackpot values or a number from 6 to 50 free
 games. The wheel spins and stops on an award. If the hit is a money or jackpot value, the amount is
 awarded, values on the wheel are increased and the wheel spins again.
 After the 5th wheel spin, the 6th level contains only free games prizes.
 When the wheel stops on an amount of free games, the free games round begins, playing the
 amount that was won.

 FIRECRACKERS

 This is the FIRECRACKER symbol.
 It appears on reels 2,3,4 during the FREE GAMES ROUND.

 Whenever a FIRECRACKER symbol hits, after the spin, it transforms randomly into and awards
 one of the following:
 - Free games retrigger - 1 to 5 more free games
 - Money values - random from 100 to 5000 x bet per line
 - Wild with multiplier - The FIRECRACKER is replaced with a WILD symbol that can have a random multiplier of
 1x, 2x, 3x or 5x that applies to the total win of the spin and also multiplies wins from other firecracker money
values. If a jackpot value is awarded on the same spin with a multiplier, the number of jackpots awarded is equal
 to the multiplier. If more than one multiplier appears on the same spin, the values multiply between each other
 - Jackpots - MAJOR, MINOR or MINI jackpot
 If at the end of the round there is no win from the free games a prize of 10x total bet is awarded.

 instantly triggered from the base game by buying it for 100x current total bet.

respins.how_it_works:
Familiar literary characters fill this slot, which sees the white rabbit, kooky hatter
and The Red Queen™ make up the symbols of this 5×3 release. These are joined
by a wild which substitutes all other symbols in game except the scatters. There
are numerous ways to increase the wins gained in the base game with stacked
symbols boosting the winning ways, while a queen respin can grant wilds
across the reels and a sixth reel can be unlocked.

game board becoming a 5×4 slot, this helps unlock winning combinations of
symbols. The features found in the base game are also present in the free spins
round and hold the key to awarding big wins!

TUMBLE FEATURE
 The TUMBLE FEATURE means that after every spin, winning combinations are paid and all winning
 symbols disappear. The remaining symbols fall to the bottom of the screen and the empty positions
 are replaced with symbols coming from above.
Tumbling will continue until no more winning combinations appear as a result of a tumble. There's no limit to the
 number of possible tumbles.
 All wins are added to the player's balance after all of the tumbles resulted from a base spin have been played.

features.name: Tumble Feature
features.effects:
The TUMBLE FEATURE means that after every spin, winning combinations are paid and all winning
 symbols disappear. The remaining symbols fall to the bottom of the screen and the empty positions
 are replaced with symbols coming from above.
Tumbling will continue until no more winning combinations appear as a result of a tumble. There's no limit to the
 number of possible tumbles.
 All wins are added to the player's balance after all of the tumbles resulted from a base spin have been played.

 The game has a locked row of symbols on top of the basic 6x5 grid. Subsequent tumbles resulted from the
 same spin can unlock positions one by one, from left to right. Once unlocked, the new positions contain
 symbols and are part of the game grid until the end of all tumbles resulted from the current spin.
 Unlocks happen as follows:
 After the first tumble the position on top of reel 1 unlocks.
 After 3 more tumbles the position on reel 2 unlocks.
 After 6 more tumbles the position on reel 3 unlocks.
 After 9 more tumbles the position on reel 4 unlocks.
